verses.kjv: These be the words which Moses spake unto all Israel on this side Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain over against the Red sea, between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
verses.modern: These are the words that Moses spoke to all Israel in the wilderness beyond the Jordan—in the plain over against the Red sea, between Paran and Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab.

verses.kjv: (There are eleven days' journey from Horeb by the way of mount Seir unto Kadeshbarnea.)
verses.modern: It is eleven days' journey from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh-barnea.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, that Moses spake unto the children of Israel, according unto all that the LORD had given him in commandment unto them;
verses.modern: In the fortieth year, on the first day of the eleventh month, Moses spoke to the people of Israel according to all that the LORD had given Him in command to them,

verses.kjv: After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites, which dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, which dwelt at Astaroth in Edrei:
verses.modern: after he had defeated Sihon the king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth and in Edrei.

verses.kjv: On this side Jordan, in the land of Moab, began Moses to declare this law, saying,
verses.modern: Beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, Moses began to explain this law, saying,

verses.kjv: The LORD our God spake unto us in Horeb, saying, Ye have dwelt long enough in this mount:
verses.modern: 'The LORD our God said to us in Horeb, "You have stayed long enough at this mountain.

verses.kjv: Turn you, and take your journey, and go to the mount of the Amorites, and unto all the places nigh thereunto, in the plain, in the hills, and in the vale, and in the south, and by the sea side, to the land of the Canaanites, and unto Lebanon, unto the great river, the river Euphrates.
verses.modern: Turn and set out on Your journey, and go to the hill country of the Amorites and to all their neighbors in the Arabah, in the hill country, in the lowland, in the south, and by the seacoast, the land of the Canaanites, and Lebanon, as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.

verses.kjv: Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give unto them and to their seed after them.
verses.modern: See, I have set the land before You. Go in and take possession of the land that the LORD swore to Your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to them and to their seed after them."

verses.kjv: And I spake unto you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you myself alone:
verses.modern: I said to You at that time, "I am not able to bear You by myself.

verses.kjv: The LORD your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.
verses.modern: The LORD Your God has multiplied You, and You are today as numerous as the stars of heaven.

verses.kjv: (The LORD God of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as ye are, and bless you, as he hath promised you!)
verses.modern: May the LORD, the God of Your fathers, make You a thousand times as many as You are and bless You, as He has promised You!

verses.kjv: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?
verses.modern: How can I bear by myself the burden and weight and strife of You?

verses.kjv: Take you wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you.
verses.modern: Choose wise, understanding, and experienced men from Your tribes. I will appoint them as Your heads."

verses.kjv: And ye answered me, and said, The thing which thou hast spoken is good for us to do.
verses.modern: You answered me, "The thing that You have spoken is good for us to do."

verses.kjv: So I took the chief of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens, and officers among your tribes.
verses.modern: So I took the heads of Your tribes, wise and experienced men, and set them as heads over You, commanders of thousands, commanders of hundreds, commanders of fifties, commanders of tens, and officers throughout Your tribes.

verses.kjv: And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear the causes between your brethren, and judge righteously between every man and his brother, and the stranger that is with him.
verses.modern: I charged Your judges at that time, "Hear the cases between Your brothers, and judge righteously between a man and his brother and the stranger who is with Him.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not respect persons in judgment; but ye shall hear the small as well as the great; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment is God's: and the cause that is too hard for you, bring it unto me, and I will hear it.
verses.modern: You shall not be partial in judgment. You shall hear the small and the great alike. You shall not be intimidated by anyone, for the judgment is God's. And the case that is too hard for You, You shall bring to me. I will hear it."

verses.kjv: And I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should do.
verses.modern: I commanded You at that time all the things that You should do.

verses.kjv: And when we departed from Horeb, we went through all that great and terrible wilderness, which ye saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites, as the LORD our God commanded us; and we came to Kadeshbarnea.
verses.modern: Then we set out from Horeb and went through all that great and terrifying wilderness that You saw, on the way to the hill country of the Amorites, as the LORD our God commanded us. And we came to Kadesh-barnea.

verses.kjv: And I said unto you, Ye are come unto the mountain of the Amorites, which the LORD our God doth give unto us.
verses.modern: I said to You, "You have come to the hill country of the Amorites, which the LORD our God is giving us.

verses.kjv: Behold, the LORD thy God hath set the land before thee: go up and possess it, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath said unto thee; fear not, neither be discouraged.
verses.modern: See, the LORD Your God has set the land before You. Go up, take possession, as the LORD, the God of Your fathers, has told You. Do not fear or be dismayed."

verses.kjv: And ye came near unto me every one of you, and said, We will send men before us, and they shall search us out the land, and bring us word again by what way we must go up, and into what cities we shall come.
verses.modern: Then all of You came near me and said, "Let us send men before us, that they may explore the land for us and bring us word again of the way by which we must go up and the cities into which we shall come."

verses.kjv: And the saying pleased me well: and I took twelve men of you, one of a tribe:
verses.modern: The plan seemed good to me. I took twelve men from You, one man from each tribe.

verses.kjv: And they turned and went up into the mountain, and came unto the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.
verses.modern: They turned and went up into the hill country, and came to the Valley of Eshcol and spied it out.

verses.kjv: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought it down unto us, and brought us word again, and said, It is a good land which the LORD our God doth give us.
verses.modern: they took in their hands some of the fruit of the land and brought it down to us, and brought us word again and said, "It is a good land that the LORD our God is giving us."

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding ye would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God:
verses.modern: Yet You would not go up, but rebelled against the command of the LORD Your God.

verses.kjv: And ye murmured in your tents, and said, Because the LORD hated us, he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.
verses.modern: you grumbled in Your tents and said, "Because the LORD hated us He has brought us out of the land of Egypt, to give us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.

verses.kjv: Whither shall we go up? our brethren have discouraged our heart, saying, The people is greater and taller than we; the cities are great and walled up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakims there.
verses.modern: Where are we going up? Our brothers have made our hearts melt, saying, 'The people are greater and taller than we are. The cities are great and fortified up to heaven. And besides, we have seen the sons of the Anakim there.' "

verses.kjv: Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.
verses.modern: Then I said to You, "Do not be in dread or afraid of them.

verses.kjv: The LORD your God which goeth before you, he shall fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;
verses.modern: The LORD Your God Who goes before You will Himself fight for You, just as He did for You in Egypt before Your eyes,

verses.kjv: And in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the LORD thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came into this place.
verses.modern: in the wilderness, where You have seen how the LORD Your God carried You, as a man carries his son, all the way that you went until You came to this place."

verses.kjv: Yet in this thing ye did not believe the LORD your God,
verses.modern: Yet in spite of this word You did not believe the LORD Your God,

verses.kjv: Who went in the way before you, to search you out a place to pitch your tents in, in fire by night, to shew you by what way ye should go, and in a cloud by day.
verses.modern: who went before You in the way to seek You out a place to camp, in fire by night and in the cloud by day, to show You by what way You should go.

verses.kjv: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and sware, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD heard Your words and was angry. He swore,

verses.kjv: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers,
verses.modern: "Not one of these men of this evil generation shall see the good land that I swore to give to Your fathers,

verses.kjv: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children, because he hath wholly followed the LORD.
verses.modern: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh. He shall see it, and to Him and to His children I will give the land on which He has trodden, because He has wholly followed the LORD!"

verses.kjv: Also the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, Thou also shalt not go in thither.
verses.modern: Even with me the LORD was angry on Your account and said, "You also shall not go in there.

verses.kjv: But Joshua the son of Nun, which standeth before thee, he shall go in thither: encourage him: for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
verses.modern: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you, he shall enter. Encourage him, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.

verses.kjv: Moreover your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, and your children, which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.
verses.modern: as for your little ones, who you said would become prey, and your children, who today have no knowledge of good or evil, they shall go in there. And to them I will give it. They shall possess it.

verses.kjv: But as for you, turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
verses.modern: But as for you, turn around and journey into the wilderness in the direction of the Red Sea."

verses.kjv: Then ye answered and said unto me, We have sinned against the LORD, we will go up and fight, according to all that the LORD our God commanded us. And when ye had girded on every man his weapons of war, ye were ready to go up into the hill country.
verses.modern: Then You answered me, "We have sinned against the LORD. We ourselves will go up and fight, just as the LORD our God commanded us." And every one of you fastened on his weapons of war and thought it easy to go up into the hill country.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto me, Say unto them, Go not up, neither fight; for I am not among you; lest ye be smitten before your enemies.
verses.modern: the LORD said to me, "Say to them, 'Do not go up or fight, for I am not among You, lest You be defeated before Your enemies.' "

verses.kjv: So I spake unto you; and ye would not hear, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD, and went presumptuously up into the hill country.
verses.modern: So I spoke to You, and You would not listen. You rebelled against the command of the LORD and presumptuously went up into the hill country.

verses.kjv: And the Amorites, which dwelt in that mountain, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir, even unto Hormah.
verses.modern: Then the Amorites who lived in that hill country came out against You and chased You as bees do and beat You down in Seir as far as Hormah.

verses.kjv: And ye returned and wept before the LORD; but the LORD would not hearken to your voice, nor give ear unto you.
verses.modern: you returned and wept before the LORD. But the LORD did not listen to Your voice or give ear to You.

verses.kjv: So ye abode in Kadesh many days, according unto the days that ye abode there.
verses.modern: So You remained at Kadesh many days, all the days that You remained there.

chapters.summary: Moses begins his farewell address to Israel on the plains of Moab, recounting their journey from Horeb to Kadesh-barnea. He recalls appointing judges, the sending of the spies, and the people's refusal to enter the land, which resulted in the entire adult generation being condemned to die in the wilderness.

verses.kjv: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea, as the LORD spake unto me: and we compassed mount Seir many days.
verses.modern: Then we turned and journeyed into the wilderness in the direction of the Red Sea, as the LORD told me. And for many days we traveled around Mount Seir.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto me, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD said to me,

verses.kjv: Ye have compassed this mountain long enough: turn you northward.
verses.modern: "You have been traveling around this mountain long enough. Turn northward.

verses.kjv: And command thou the people, saying, Ye are to pass through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau, which dwell in Seir; and they shall be afraid of you: take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore:
verses.modern: command the people, 'You are about to pass through the territory of your brothers, the people of Esau, who live in Seir. They will be afraid of you. So be very careful.

verses.kjv: Meddle not with them; for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as a foot breadth; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession.
verses.modern: Do not contend with them, for I will not give you any of their land, not even as much as a foot's breadth, because I have given Mount Seir to Esau as a possession.

verses.kjv: Ye shall buy meat of them for money, that ye may eat; and ye shall also buy water of them for money, that ye may drink.
verses.modern: You shall purchase food from them with money so that you may eat, and you shall also buy water from them with money so that you may drink."

verses.kjv: For the LORD thy God hath blessed thee in all the works of thine hand: he knoweth thy walking through this great wilderness: these forty years the LORD thy God hath been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.
verses.modern: For the LORD Your God has blessed You in all the work of Your hands. He knows Your going through this great wilderness. These forty years the LORD Your God has been with You. You have lacked nothing.'

verses.kjv: And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, through the way of the plain from Elath, and from Eziongaber, we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.
verses.modern: So we went on away from our brothers the people of Esau who live in Seir, away from the Arabah road from Elath and Ezion-geber. And we turned and went in the direction of the wilderness of Moab.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto me, Distress not the Moabites, neither contend with them in battle: for I will not give thee of their land for a possession; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession.
verses.modern: the LORD said to me, "Do not harass Moab or contend with them in battle, for I will not give You any of their land for a possession, because I have given Ar to the people of Lot for a possession."

verses.kjv: The Emims dwelt therein in times past, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims;
verses.modern: (The Emim formerly lived there, a great and numerous people, tall as the Anakim.

verses.kjv: Which also were accounted giants, as the Anakims; but the Moabites call them Emims.
verses.modern: Like the Anakim they are also counted as giants, but the Moabites call them Emim.

verses.kjv: The Horims also dwelt in Seir beforetime; but the children of Esau succeeded them, when they had destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their stead; as Israel did unto the land of his possession, which the LORD gave unto them.
verses.modern: The Horites also lived in Seir formerly, but the people of Esau dispossessed them and destroyed them from before them and settled in their place, as Israel did to the land of their possession, which the LORD gave to them.)

verses.kjv: Now rise up, said I, and get you over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.
verses.modern: "Now rise up and go over the brook Zered." So we went over the brook Zered.

verses.kjv: And the space in which we came from Kadeshbarnea, until we were come over the brook Zered, was thirty and eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host, as the LORD sware unto them.
verses.modern: the time from our leaving Kadesh-barnea until we crossed the brook Zered was thirty-eight years, until the entire generation of warriors had perished from the camp, as the LORD had sworn to them.

verses.kjv: For indeed the hand of the LORD was against them, to destroy them from among the host, until they were consumed.
verses.modern: For indeed the hand of the LORD was against them, to destroy them from the camp, until they had perished.

verses.kjv: So it came to pass, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,
verses.modern: So as soon as all the men of war had perished and were dead from among the people,

verses.kjv: That the LORD spake unto me, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD said to me,

verses.kjv: Thou art to pass over through Ar, the coast of Moab, this day:
verses.modern: "Today You are to cross the border of Moab at Ar.

verses.kjv: And when thou comest nigh over against the children of Ammon, distress them not, nor meddle with them: for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon any possession; because I have given it unto the children of Lot for a possession.
verses.modern: when you approach the territory of the people of Ammon, do not harass them or contend with them, for I will not give you any of the land of the people of Ammon as a possession, because I have given it to the people of Lot for a possession."

verses.kjv: (That also was accounted a land of giants: giants dwelt therein in old time; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims;
verses.modern: (It is also counted as a land of giants. Giants formerly lived there—but the Ammonites call them Zamzummim—

verses.kjv: A people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims; but the LORD destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead:
verses.modern: a people great and numerous and tall as the Anakim; but the LORD destroyed them before them. They dispossessed them and settled in their place,

verses.kjv: As he did to the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, when he destroyed the Horims from before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead even unto this day:
verses.modern: just as he had done for the people of Esau, who live in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites before them. They dispossessed them and settled in their place even to this day.

verses.kjv: And the Avims which dwelt in Hazerim, even unto Azzah, the Caphtorims, which came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.)
verses.modern: As for the Avvim, who lived in villages as far as Gaza, the Caphtorim, who came from Caphtor, destroyed them and settled in their place.)

verses.kjv: Rise ye up, take your journey, and pass over the river Arnon: behold, I have given into thine hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land: begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.
verses.modern: "Rise up, set out on your journey and go over the Valley of the Arnon. See, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land. Begin to take possession of it and contend with him in battle.

verses.kjv: This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the nations that are under the whole heaven, who shall hear report of thee, and shall tremble, and be in anguish because of thee.
verses.modern: This day I will begin to put the dread and fear of you on the peoples who are under the whole heaven, who shall hear the report of you and shall tremble and be in anguish because of you."

verses.kjv: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,
verses.modern: So I sent messengers from the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon the king of Heshbon, with words of peace, saying,

verses.kjv: Let me pass through thy land: I will go along by the high way, I will neither turn unto the right hand nor to the left.
verses.modern: "Let me pass through your land. I will go only along the road. I will turn aside neither to the right nor to the left.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt sell me meat for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink: only I will pass through on my feet;
verses.modern: You shall sell me food for money, that I may eat, and give me water for money, that I may drink. Only let me pass through on foot,

verses.kjv: (As the children of Esau which dwell in Seir, and the Moabites which dwell in Ar, did unto me;) until I shall pass over Jordan into the land which the LORD our God giveth us.
verses.modern: as the people of Esau who live in Seir and the Moabites who live in Ar did for me, until I cross the Jordan into the land the LORD our God is giving us."

verses.kjv: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him: for the LORD thy God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into thy hand, as appeareth this day.
verses.modern: But Sihon the king of Heshbon would not let us pass through, for the LORD Your God hardened His spirit and made His heart obstinate, that He might give Him into Your hand, as He is this day.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have begun to give Sihon and his land before thee: begin to possess, that thou mayest inherit his land.
verses.modern: the LORD said to me, "See, I have begun to give Sihon and His land over to You. Begin to take possession, that You may occupy His land."

verses.kjv: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.
verses.modern: Then Sihon came out against us, He and all His people, to battle at Jahaz.

verses.kjv: And the LORD our God delivered him before us; and we smote him, and his sons, and all his people.
verses.modern: the LORD our God gave Him over to us. We defeated Him and His sons and all His people.

verses.kjv: And we took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed the men, and the women, and the little ones, of every city, we left none to remain:
verses.modern: we captured all His cities at that time and devoted to destruction every city—men, women, and children. We left no survivors.

verses.kjv: Only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves, and the spoil of the cities which we took.
verses.modern: Only the livestock we took as plunder for ourselves, with the spoil of the cities that we captured.

verses.kjv: From Aroer, which is by the brink of the river of Arnon, and from the city that is by the river, even unto Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us: the LORD our God delivered all unto us:
verses.modern: From Aroer, which is on the edge of the Valley of the Arnon, and from the city that is in the valley, as far as Gilead, there was not a city too high for us. The LORD our God gave all into our hands.

verses.kjv: Only unto the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not, and unto all the places by the river Jabbok, and the cities in the mountains, and wheresoever the LORD our God forbad us.
verses.modern: Only to the land of the people of Ammon you did not draw near, that is, to all the banks of the river Jabbok and the cities of the hill country, wherever the LORD our God had forbidden us.

chapters.summary: Moses recounts how Israel wandered in the wilderness for thirty-eight years until the generation of fighting men had perished. He recalls their passage around Edom, Moab, and Ammon -- lands the LORD had given to Esau and Lot's descendants -- and Israel's defeat of Sihon king of Heshbon.

verses.kjv: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
verses.modern: Then we turned and went up the road to Bashan. And Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto me, Fear him not: for I will deliver him, and all his people, and his land, into thy hand; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.
verses.modern: But the LORD said to me, "Do not fear Him, for I have given Him and all His people and His land into Your hand. And You shall do to Him as You did to Sihon the king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon."

verses.kjv: So the LORD our God delivered into our hands Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people: and we smote him until none was left to him remaining.
verses.modern: So the LORD our God gave into our hands Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people. We struck him down until He had no survivor left.

verses.kjv: And we took all his cities at that time, there was not a city which we took not from them, threescore cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.modern: we took all His cities at that time—there was not a city that we did not take from them—sixty cities, the whole region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

verses.kjv: All these cities were fenced with high walls, gates, and bars; beside unwalled towns a great many.
verses.modern: All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars, besides very many unwalled villages.

verses.kjv: And we utterly destroyed them, as we did unto Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children, of every city.
verses.modern: we devoted them to destruction, as we did to Sihon the king of Heshbon, devoting to destruction every city—men, women, and children.

verses.kjv: But all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we took for a prey to ourselves.
verses.modern: But all the livestock and the spoil of the cities we took as our plunder.

verses.kjv: And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites the land that was on this side Jordan, from the river of Arnon unto mount Hermon;
verses.modern: So we took the land at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, from the Valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon

verses.kjv: (Which Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion; and the Amorites call it Shenir;)
verses.modern: (the Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, while the Amorites call it Senir),

verses.kjv: All the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.modern: all the cities of the tableland and all Gilead and all Bashan, as far as Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

verses.kjv: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants; behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbath of the children of Ammon? nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.
verses.modern: (For only Og the king of Bashan was left of the remnant of the giants. His bed was a bed of iron. Is it not in Rabbah of the people of Ammon? Nine cubits was its length, and four cubits its breadth, according to the common cubit.)

verses.kjv: And this land, which we possessed at that time, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, and half mount Gilead, and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites.
verses.modern: When we took possession of this land at that time, I gave to the Reubenites and the Gadites the territory beginning at Aroer, which is on the edge of the Valley of the Arnon, and half the hill country of Gilead with its cities.

verses.kjv: And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, being the kingdom of Og, gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of giants.
verses.modern: The rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, that is, all the region of Argob, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh. (All that portion of Bashan is called the land of giants.

verses.kjv: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob unto the coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi; and called them after his own name, Bashanhavothjair, unto this day.
verses.modern: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob, that is, Bashan, as far as the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and called the villages after his own name, Havvoth-jair, as it is to this day.)

verses.kjv: And I gave Gilead unto Machir.
verses.modern: I gave Gilead to Machir.

verses.kjv: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley, and the border even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.modern: To the Reubenites and the Gadites I gave the territory from Gilead as far as the Valley of the Arnon, with the middle of the valley as a border, as far as the river Jabbok, the border of the people of Ammon;

verses.kjv: The plain also, and Jordan, and the coast thereof, from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, under Ashdothpisgah eastward.
verses.modern: the Arabah also, with the Jordan as the border, from Chinnereth as far as the Sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, under the slopes of Pisgah on the east.

verses.kjv: And I commanded you at that time, saying, The LORD your God hath given you this land to possess it: ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel, all that are meet for the war.
verses.modern: I commanded You at that time, "The LORD Your God has given You this land to possess. All Your men of valor shall cross over armed before Your brothers, the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, (for I know that ye have much cattle,) shall abide in your cities which I have given you;
verses.modern: Only Your wives, Your little ones, and Your livestock—I know that You have much livestock—shall remain in the cities I have given You,

verses.kjv: Until the LORD have given rest unto your brethren, as well as unto you, and until they also possess the land which the LORD your God hath given them beyond Jordan: and then shall ye return every man unto his possession which I have given you.
verses.modern: until the LORD gives rest to Your brothers, as to You. They also occupy the land that the LORD Your God is giving them beyond the Jordan. Then each of You may return to His possession that I have given You."

verses.kjv: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Thine eyes have seen all that the LORD your God hath done unto these two kings: so shall the LORD do unto all the kingdoms whither thou passest.
verses.modern: I commanded Joshua at that time, "Your eyes have seen all that the LORD your God has done to these two kings. So will the LORD do to all the kingdoms into which You are about to cross.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not fear them: for the LORD your God he shall fight for you.
verses.modern: You shall not fear them, for it is the LORD Your God Who fights for You."

verses.kjv: And I besought the LORD at that time, saying,
verses.modern: I pleaded with the LORD at that time, saying,

verses.kjv: O Lord GOD, thou hast begun to shew thy servant thy greatness, and thy mighty hand: for what God is there in heaven or in earth, that can do according to thy works, and according to thy might?
verses.modern: "O Lord GOD, You have only begun to show Your servant Your greatness and Your mighty hand. For what god is there in heaven or on earth who can do such works and mighty acts as Yours?

verses.kjv: I pray thee, let me go over, and see the good land that is beyond Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.
verses.modern: Please let me go over and see the good land beyond the Jordan, that good hill country and Lebanon."

verses.kjv: But the LORD was wroth with me for your sakes, and would not hear me: and the LORD said unto me, Let it suffice thee; speak no more unto me of this matter.
verses.modern: But the LORD was angry with me because of You and would not listen to me. And the LORD said to me, "Enough from You; do not speak to me of this matter again.

verses.kjv: Get thee up into the top of Pisgah, and lift up thine eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold it with thine eyes: for thou shalt not go over this Jordan.
verses.modern: Go up to the top of Pisgah and lift up Your eyes westward and northward and southward and eastward, and look at it with Your eyes, for You shall not go over this Jordan.

verses.kjv: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.
verses.modern: But commission Joshua, and encourage and strengthen him, for he shall go over at the head of this people. He shall put them in possession of the land that you shall see."

verses.kjv: So we abode in the valley over against Bethpeor.
verses.modern: So we remained in the valley opposite Beth-peor.

chapters.summary: Moses recounts the defeat of Og king of Bashan and the division of the conquered land east of the Jordan to Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh. He tells how he pleaded with the LORD to let him cross into the Promised Land, but the LORD refused and told him to commission Joshua instead.

verses.kjv: Now therefore hearken, O Israel, unto the statutes and unto the judgments, which I teach you, for to do them, that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers giveth you.
verses.modern: Now, O Israel, listen to the statutes and the rules that I am teaching you, and do them, that You may live, and go in and take possession of the land that the LORD, the God of Your fathers, is giving You.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.
verses.modern: You shall not add to the word that I command You, nor take from it, that You may keep the commandments of the LORD Your God that I command You.

verses.kjv: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baalpeor: for all the men that followed Baalpeor, the LORD thy God hath destroyed them from among you.
verses.modern: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did at Baal-peor, for the LORD Your God destroyed from among You all the men who followed the Baal of Peor.

verses.kjv: But ye that did cleave unto the LORD your God are alive every one of you this day.
verses.modern: But You who held fast to the LORD Your God are all alive today.

verses.kjv: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it.
verses.modern: See, I have taught You statutes and rules, as the LORD my God commanded me, that You should do them in the land that You are entering to take possession of it.

verses.kjv: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.
verses.modern: Keep them and do them, for that will be Your wisdom and Your understanding in the sight of the peoples, who, when they hear all these statutes, will say, "Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people."

verses.kjv: For what nation is there so great, who hath God so nigh unto them, as the LORD our God is in all things that we call upon him for?
verses.modern: For what great nation is there that has a god so near to it as the LORD our God is to us, whenever we call upon Him?

verses.kjv: And what nation is there so great, that hath statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?
verses.modern: what great nation is there that has statutes and rules so righteous as all this law that I set before You today?

verses.kjv: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life: but teach them thy sons, and thy sons' sons;
verses.modern: Only take care, and keep Your soul diligently, lest You forget the things that Your eyes have seen, and lest they depart from Your heart all the days of Your life. Make them known to Your children and Your children's children—

verses.kjv: Specially the day that thou stoodest before the LORD thy God in Horeb, when the LORD said unto me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and that they may teach their children.
verses.modern: especially the day You stood before the LORD Your God at Horeb, when the LORD said to me, "Gather the people to me, that I may let them hear my words, so that they may learn to fear me all the days that they live on the earth, and that they may teach their children so."

verses.kjv: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.
verses.modern: you came near and stood at the foot of the mountain, while the mountain burned with fire to the heart of heaven, wrapped in darkness, cloud, and deep gloom.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only ye heard a voice.
verses.modern: Then the LORD spoke to You out of the midst of the fire. You heard the sound of words, but saw no form; there was only a voice.

verses.kjv: And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.
verses.modern: he declared to You His covenant, which He commanded You to perform, that is, the Ten Commandments. He wrote them on two tablets of stone.

verses.kjv: And the LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it.
verses.modern: the LORD commanded me at that time to teach You statutes and rules, that You might do them in the land that You are going over to possess.

verses.kjv: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day that the LORD spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire:
verses.modern: Therefore watch yourselves very carefully. Since You saw no form on the day that the LORD spoke to You at Horeb out of the midst of the fire,

verses.kjv: Lest ye corrupt yourselves, and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
verses.modern: beware lest You act corruptly by making a carved image for yourselves, in the form of any figure, the likeness of male or female,

verses.kjv: The likeness of any beast that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air,
verses.modern: the likeness of any animal that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged bird that flies in the air,

verses.kjv: The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth:
verses.modern: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth.

verses.kjv: And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which the LORD thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.
verses.modern: beware lest You raise Your eyes to heaven, and when You see the sun and the moon and the stars, all the host of heaven, You be drawn away and bow down to them and serve them, things that the LORD Your God has allotted to all the peoples under the whole heaven.

verses.kjv: But the LORD hath taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace, even out of Egypt, to be unto him a people of inheritance, as ye are this day.
verses.modern: But the LORD has taken You and brought You out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be a people of His own inheritance, as You are this day.

verses.kjv: Furthermore the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance:
verses.modern: Furthermore, the LORD was angry with me because of You. He swore that I should not cross the Jordan, and that I should not enter the good land that the LORD Your God is giving You for an inheritance.

verses.kjv: But I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan: but ye shall go over, and possess that good land.
verses.modern: For I must die in this land; I must not go over the Jordan. But You shall go over and take possession of that good land.

verses.kjv: Take heed unto yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make you a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, which the LORD thy God hath forbidden thee.
verses.modern: Take care, lest You forget the covenant of the LORD Your God, which He made with You, and make a carved image, the form of anything that the LORD Your God has forbidden You.

verses.kjv: For the LORD thy God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.
verses.modern: For the LORD Your God is a consuming fire, a jealous God.

verses.kjv: When thou shalt beget children, and children's children, and ye shall have remained long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, and shall do evil in the sight of the LORD thy God, to provoke him to anger:
verses.modern: When You father children and children's children, and have grown old in the land, if You act corruptly by making a carved image in the form of anything, and by doing what is evil in the sight of the LORD Your God, provoking Him to anger,

verses.kjv: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.
verses.modern: I call heaven and earth to witness against You today, that You will soon utterly perish from the land that You are going over the Jordan to possess. You will not live long in it, but will be utterly destroyed.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the LORD shall lead you.
verses.modern: the LORD will scatter You among the peoples, and You will be left few in number among the nations where the LORD will drive You.

verses.kjv: And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men's hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
verses.modern: there You will serve gods of wood and stone, the work of human hands, that neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.

verses.kjv: But if from thence thou shalt seek the LORD thy God, thou shalt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.
verses.modern: But from there You will seek the LORD Your God and You will find Him, if You search after Him with all Your heart and with all Your soul.

verses.kjv: When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come upon thee, even in the latter days, if thou turn to the LORD thy God, and shalt be obedient unto his voice;
verses.modern: When You are in tribulation, and all these things come upon You in the latter days, You will return to the LORD Your God and obey His voice.

verses.kjv: (For the LORD thy God is a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.
verses.modern: For the LORD Your God is a merciful God. He will not leave You or destroy You or forget the covenant with Your fathers that He swore to them.

verses.kjv: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and ask from the one side of heaven unto the other, whether there hath been any such thing as this great thing is, or hath been heard like it?
verses.modern: For ask now of the days that are past, from the day God created man on the earth, and ask from one end of heaven to the other, whether such a great thing as this has ever happened or was ever heard of.

verses.kjv: Did ever people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?
verses.modern: Did any people ever hear the voice of a god speaking out of the midst of the fire, as You have heard, and still live?

verses.kjv: Or hath God assayed to go and take him a nation from the midst of another nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
verses.modern: Or has any god ever attempted to go and take a nation for Himself from the midst of another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by war, by a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, and by great deeds of terror, all of which the LORD Your God did for You in Egypt before Your eyes?

verses.kjv: Unto thee it was shewed, that thou mightest know that the LORD he is God; there is none else beside him.
verses.modern: To You it was shown, that You might know that the LORD is God; there is no other besides Him.

verses.kjv: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice, that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire.
verses.modern: Out of heaven He let You hear His voice, that He might discipline You. And on earth He let You see His great fire, and You heard His words out of the midst of the fire.

verses.kjv: And because he loved thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt;
verses.modern: because He loved Your fathers and chose their seed after them and brought You out of Egypt with His own presence, by His great power,

verses.kjv: To drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou art, to bring thee in, to give thee their land for an inheritance, as it is this day.
verses.modern: driving out before You nations greater and mightier than you, to bring you in, to give you their land for an inheritance, as it is this day,

verses.kjv: Know therefore this day, and consider it in thine heart, that the LORD he is God in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath: there is none else.
verses.modern: know therefore today, and lay it to Your heart, that the LORD is God in heaven above and on the earth beneath; there is no other.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes, and his commandments, which I command thee this day, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayest prolong thy days upon the earth, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, for ever.
verses.modern: Therefore You shall keep His statutes and His commandments, which I command You today, that it may go well with You and with Your children after You, and that You may prolong Your days in the land that the LORD Your God is giving You for all time.

verses.kjv: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;
verses.modern: Then Moses set apart three cities in the east beyond the Jordan,

verses.kjv: That the slayer might flee thither, which should kill his neighbour unawares, and hated him not in times past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:
verses.modern: that the manslayer might flee there, anyone who kills his neighbor unintentionally, without having hated him in the past; he could flee to one of these cities and live:

verses.kjv: Namely, Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.
verses.modern: Bezer in the wilderness on the tableland for the Reubenites, Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites, and Golan in Bashan for the Manassites.

verses.kjv: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel:
verses.modern: This is the law that Moses set before the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spake unto the children of Israel, after they came forth out of Egypt,
verses.modern: These are the testimonies, the statutes, and the rules, which Moses spoke to the people of Israel when they came out of Egypt,

verses.kjv: On this side Jordan, in the valley over against Bethpeor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote, after they were come forth out of Egypt:
verses.modern: beyond the Jordan in the valley opposite Beth-peor, in the land of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon, whom Moses and the people of Israel defeated when they came out of Egypt.

verses.kjv: And they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, which were on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;
verses.modern: they took possession of his land and the land of Og, the king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites, who lived to the east beyond the Jordan;

verses.kjv: From Aroer, which is by the bank of the river Arnon, even unto mount Sion, which is Hermon,
verses.modern: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the Valley of the Arnon, as far as mount Sion, which is Hermon,

verses.kjv: And all the plain on this side Jordan eastward, even unto the sea of the plain, under the springs of Pisgah.
verses.modern: together with all the Arabah on the east side of the Jordan as far as the Sea of the Arabah, under the slopes of Pisgah.

chapters.summary: Moses urges Israel to obey the LORD's statutes so they may live and possess the land. He warns them against making graven images and reminds them of what they saw at Horeb -- they heard a voice but saw no form. He establishes three cities of refuge east of the Jordan.

verses.kjv: And Moses called all Israel, and said unto them, Hear, O Israel, the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day, that ye may learn them, and keep, and do them.
verses.modern: Moses summoned all Israel and said to them, "Hear, O Israel, the statutes and the rules that I speak in your hearing today, and you shall learn them and be careful to do them.

verses.kjv: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.
verses.modern: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.

verses.kjv: The LORD made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive this day.
verses.modern: Not with our fathers did the LORD make this covenant, but with us, who are all of us here alive today.

verses.kjv: The LORD talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire,
verses.modern: The LORD spoke with You face to face at the mountain, out of the midst of the fire,

verses.kjv: (I stood between the LORD and you at that time, to shew you the word of the LORD: for ye were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up into the mount;) saying,
verses.modern: while I stood between the LORD and You at that time, to declare to You the word of the LORD. For You were afraid because of the fire, and You did not go up into the mountain. He said:

verses.kjv: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
verses.modern: "I am the LORD Your God, Who brought You out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt have none other gods before me.
verses.modern: You shall have no other gods before me.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not make thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the waters beneath the earth:
verses.modern: You shall not make for Yourself a carved image, or any likeness of anything that is in heaven above, or that is on the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me,
verses.modern: You shall not bow down to them or serve them; for I the LORD Your God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children to the third and fourth generation of those who hate me,

verses.kjv: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.
verses.modern: but showing mercy to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain: for the LORD thy God will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
verses.modern: You shall not take the name of the LORD Your God in vain, for the LORD Your God will not hold Him guiltless who takes His name in vain.

verses.kjv: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee.
verses.modern: Observe the Sabbath day, to keep it holy, as the LORD Your God commanded You.

verses.kjv: Six days thou shalt labour, and do all thy work:
verses.modern: Six days You shall labor and do all Your work,

verses.kjv: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the LORD thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thine ox, nor thine ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates; that thy manservant and thy maidservant may rest as well as thou.
verses.modern: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD Your God. On it You shall not do any work, You or Your son or Your daughter or Your male servant or Your female servant, or Your ox or Your donkey or any of Your livestock, or the foreigner who is within Your gates, that Your male servant and Your female servant may rest as well as You.

verses.kjv: And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and that the LORD thy God brought thee out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm: therefore the LORD thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day.
verses.modern: You shall remember that You were a slave in the land of Egypt. The LORD Your God brought You out from there with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. Therefore the LORD Your God commanded You to keep the Sabbath day.

verses.kjv: Honour thy father and thy mother, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee; that thy days may be prolonged, and that it may go well with thee, in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
verses.modern: Honor Your father and Your mother, as the LORD Your God commanded You, that Your days may be long, and that it may go well with You in the land that the LORD Your God is giving You.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not kill.
verses.modern: You shall not kill.

verses.kjv: Neither shalt thou commit adultery.
verses.modern: you shall not commit adultery.

verses.kjv: Neither shalt thou steal.
verses.modern: you shall not steal.

verses.kjv: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour.
verses.modern: you shall not bear false witness against Your neighbor.

verses.kjv: Neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour's wife, neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour's house, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or any thing that is thy neighbour's.
verses.modern: you shall not covet Your neighbor's wife. And You shall not desire Your neighbor's house, His field, or His male servant, or His female servant, His ox, or his donkey, or anything that is Your neighbor's.

verses.kjv: These words the LORD spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice: and he added no more. And he wrote them in two tables of stone, and delivered them unto me.
verses.modern: These words the LORD spoke to all Your assembly at the mountain out of the midst of the fire, the cloud, and the thick darkness, with a loud voice. He added no more. And He wrote them on two tablets of stone and gave them to me.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, (for the mountain did burn with fire,) that ye came near unto me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;
verses.modern: as soon as You heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, while the mountain was burning with fire, You came near to me, all the heads of Your tribes, and Your elders.

verses.kjv: And ye said, Behold, the LORD our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that God doth talk with man, and he liveth.
verses.modern: you said, "The LORD our God has shown us His glory and greatness. We have heard His voice out of the midst of the fire. This day we have seen God speak with man, and man still live.

verses.kjv: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any more, then we shall die.
verses.modern: Now therefore why should we die? For this great fire will consume us. If we hear the voice of the LORD our God any more, we shall die.

verses.kjv: For who is there of all flesh, that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?
verses.modern: For who is there of all flesh, that has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of fire as we have, and has still lived?

verses.kjv: Go thou near, and hear all that the LORD our God shall say: and speak thou unto us all that the LORD our God shall speak unto thee; and we will hear it, and do it.
verses.modern: Go near and hear all that the LORD our God will say, and speak to us all that the LORD our God will speak to You. We will hear and do it."

verses.kjv: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, when ye spake unto me; and the LORD said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken unto thee: they have well said all that they have spoken.
verses.modern: the LORD heard Your words, when You spoke to me. And the LORD said to me, "I have heard the words of this people, which they have spoken to You. They are right in all that they have spoken.

verses.kjv: O that there were such an heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!
verses.modern: Oh that they had such a heart as this always, to fear me and to keep all my commandments, that it might go well with them and with their descendants forever!

verses.kjv: Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.
verses.modern: Go and say to them, "Return to Your tents."

verses.kjv: But as for thee, stand thou here by me, and I will speak unto thee all the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which thou shalt teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it.
verses.modern: But You, stand here by me. I will tell You the whole commandment and the statutes and the rules that You shall teach them, that they may do them in the land that I am giving them to possess."

verses.kjv: Ye shall observe to do therefore as the LORD your God hath commanded you: ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
verses.modern: You shall be careful therefore to do as the LORD Your God has commanded You. You shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.

verses.kjv: Ye shall walk in all the ways which the LORD your God hath commanded you, that ye may live, and that it may be well with you, and that ye may prolong your days in the land which ye shall possess.
verses.modern: You shall walk in all the way that the LORD Your God has commanded You, that You may live, and that it may go well with You, and that You may live long in the land that You shall possess.

chapters.summary: Moses restates the Ten Commandments given at Horeb. He reminds the people that the LORD spoke to them face to face out of the fire, and that they were so afraid they asked Moses to be their mediator with God.

verses.kjv: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD your God commanded to teach you, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go to possess it:
verses.modern: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the rules that the LORD Your God commanded me to teach You, that You may do them in the land to which You are going over to possess it,

verses.kjv: That thou mightest fear the LORD thy God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son's son, all the days of thy life; and that thy days may be prolonged.
verses.modern: so that You may fear the LORD Your God, You and Your son and Your son's son, by keeping all His statutes and His commandments that I command You, all the days of Your life, and that Your days may be long.

verses.kjv: Hear therefore, O Israel, and observe to do it; that it may be well with thee, and that ye may increase mightily, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath promised thee, in the land that floweth with milk and honey.
verses.modern: Hear therefore, O Israel, and be careful to do them, that it may go well with you, and that you may multiply greatly, as the LORD, the God of Your fathers, has promised You, in a land flowing with milk and honey.

verses.kjv: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD:
verses.modern: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God, the LORD is one.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.
verses.modern: You shall love the LORD Your God with all Your heart and with all Your soul and with all Your might.

verses.kjv: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart:
verses.modern: these words that I command You today shall be on Your heart.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
verses.modern: You shall teach them diligently to Your children, and shall talk of them when You sit in Your house, and when You walk by the way, and when You lie down, and when You rise.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand, and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes.
verses.modern: You shall bind them as a sign on Your hand. They shall be as frontlets between Your eyes.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house, and on thy gates.
verses.modern: You shall write them on the doorposts of Your house and on Your gates.

verses.kjv: And it shall be, when the LORD thy God shall have brought thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee great and goodly cities, which thou buildedst not,
verses.modern: when the LORD Your God brings You into the land that He swore to Your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give you—with great and good cities that You did not build,

verses.kjv: And houses full of all good things, which thou filledst not, and wells digged, which thou diggedst not, vineyards and olive trees, which thou plantedst not; when thou shalt have eaten and be full;
verses.modern: houses full of all good things that You did not fill, and cisterns that You did not dig, and vineyards and olive trees that You did not plant—and when You eat and are full,

verses.kjv: Then beware lest thou forget the LORD, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
verses.modern: then take care lest You forget the LORD, Who brought You out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.
verses.modern: It is the LORD Your God You shall fear. Him You shall serve and by His name You shall swear.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the people which are round about you;
verses.modern: You shall not go after other gods, the gods of the peoples who are around You—

verses.kjv: (For the LORD thy God is a jealous God among you) lest the anger of the LORD thy God be kindled against thee, and destroy thee from off the face of the earth.
verses.modern: for the LORD Your God in Your midst is a jealous God—lest the anger of the LORD Your God be kindled against You, and destroy You from off the face of the earth.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not tempt the LORD your God, as ye tempted him in Massah.
verses.modern: You shall not put the LORD Your God to the test, as You tested Him at Massah.

verses.kjv: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he hath commanded thee.
verses.modern: You shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD Your God, and His testimonies and His statutes which He has commanded You.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt do that which is right and good in the sight of the LORD: that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers,
verses.modern: you shall do what is right and good in the sight of the LORD, that it may go well with You, and that You may go in and take possession of the good land that the LORD swore to give to Your fathers

verses.kjv: To cast out all thine enemies from before thee, as the LORD hath spoken.
verses.modern: by driving out all Your enemies from before You, as the LORD has promised.

verses.kjv: And when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What mean the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD our God hath commanded you?
verses.modern: When Your son asks You in time to come, "What is the meaning of the testimonies and the statutes and the rules that the LORD our God has commanded You?"

verses.kjv: Then thou shalt say unto thy son, We were Pharaoh's bondmen in Egypt; and the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand:
verses.modern: then You shall say to Your son, "We were Pharaoh's slaves in Egypt. And the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shewed signs and wonders, great and sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his household, before our eyes:
verses.modern: the LORD showed signs and wonders, great and grievous, against Egypt and against Pharaoh and all his household, before our eyes.

verses.kjv: And he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers.
verses.modern: he brought us out from there, that He might bring us in and give us the land that He swore to give to our fathers.

verses.kjv: And the LORD commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as it is at this day.
verses.modern: the LORD commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God, for our good always, that He might preserve us alive, as we are this day.

verses.kjv: And it shall be our righteousness, if we observe to do all these commandments before the LORD our God, as he hath commanded us.
verses.modern: it will be righteousness for us, if we are careful to do all this commandment before the LORD our God, as He has commanded us."

chapters.summary: Moses commands Israel to love the LORD their God with all their heart, soul, and might, and to teach these words diligently to their children. He warns them not to forget the LORD when they enter the Promised Land and enjoy its abundance.

verses.kjv: When the LORD thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it, and hath cast out many nations before thee, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than thou;
verses.modern: When the LORD Your God brings You into the land that You are entering to take possession of it, and clears away many nations before You—the Hittites, the Girgashites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations more numerous and mightier than You—

verses.kjv: And when the LORD thy God shall deliver them before thee; thou shalt smite them, and utterly destroy them; thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor shew mercy unto them:
verses.modern: when the LORD Your God gives them over to You, and You defeat them, then You must devote them to complete destruction. You shall make no covenant with them and show them no mercy.

verses.kjv: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.
verses.modern: You shall not intermarry with them, giving Your daughters to their sons or taking their daughters for Your sons,

verses.kjv: For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and destroy thee suddenly.
verses.modern: for they would turn away Your sons from following me, to serve other gods. Then the anger of the LORD would be kindled against You. He would destroy You quickly.

verses.kjv: But thus shall ye deal with them; ye shall destroy their altars, and break down their images, and cut down their groves, and burn their graven images with fire.
verses.modern: But thus shall You deal with them: You shall break down their altars and dash in pieces their pillars and chop down their groves and burn their carved images with fire.

verses.kjv: For thou art an holy people unto the LORD thy God: the LORD thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.
verses.modern: For You are a people holy to the LORD Your God. The LORD Your God has chosen You to be a people for His treasured possession, out of all the peoples who are on the face of the earth.

verses.kjv: The LORD did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye were the fewest of all people:
verses.modern: It was not because You were more in number than any other people that the LORD set His love on You and chose You, for You were the fewest of all peoples,

verses.kjv: But because the LORD loved you, and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers, hath the LORD brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
verses.modern: but it is because the LORD loves You and is keeping the oath that He swore to Your fathers, that the LORD has brought You out with a mighty hand and redeemed You from the house of slavery, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

verses.kjv: Know therefore that the LORD thy God, he is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;
verses.modern: Know therefore that the LORD Your God is God, the faithful God Who keeps covenant and mercy with those who love Him and keep His commandments, to a thousand generations,

verses.kjv: And repayeth them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hateth him, he will repay him to his face.
verses.modern: repays to their face those who hate Him, by destroying them. He will not be slack with one who hates Him. He will repay Him to His face.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which I command thee this day, to do them.
verses.modern: You shall therefore be careful to do the commandment and the statutes and the rules that I command You today.

verses.kjv: Wherefore it shall come to pass, if ye hearken to these judgments, and keep, and do them, that the LORD thy God shall keep unto thee the covenant and the mercy which he sware unto thy fathers:
verses.modern: because You listen to these rules and keep and do them, the LORD Your God will keep with You the covenant and the mercy that He swore to Your fathers.

verses.kjv: And he will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee: he will also bless the fruit of thy womb, and the fruit of thy land, thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep, in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee.
verses.modern: He will love You, bless You, and multiply You. He will also bless the fruit of Your womb and the fruit of Your ground, Your grain and Your wine and Your oil, the increase of Your herds and the young of Your flock, in the land that He swore to Your fathers to give You.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt be blessed above all people: there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.
verses.modern: You shall be blessed above all peoples. There shall not be male or female barren among You or among Your livestock.

verses.kjv: And the LORD will take away from thee all sickness, and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which thou knowest, upon thee; but will lay them upon all them that hate thee.
verses.modern: the LORD will take away from You all sickness, and none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which You knew, will He inflict on You. But He will lay them on all who hate You.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt consume all the people which the LORD thy God shall deliver thee; thine eye shall have no pity upon them: neither shalt thou serve their gods; for that will be a snare unto thee.
verses.modern: you shall consume all the peoples that the LORD Your God will give over to You. Your eye shall not pity them, neither shall You serve their gods, for that would be a snare to You.

verses.kjv: If thou shalt say in thine heart, These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?
verses.modern: If You say in Your heart, "These nations are greater than I. How can I dispossess them?"

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not be afraid of them: but shalt well remember what the LORD thy God did unto Pharaoh, and unto all Egypt;
verses.modern: you shall not be afraid of them but You shall remember what the LORD Your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt,

verses.kjv: The great temptations which thine eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the stretched out arm, whereby the LORD thy God brought thee out: so shall the LORD thy God do unto all the people of whom thou art afraid.
verses.modern: the great trials that Your eyes saw, the signs, the wonders, the mighty hand, and the outstretched arm, by which the LORD Your God brought You out. So will the LORD Your God do to all the peoples of whom You are afraid.

verses.kjv: Moreover the LORD thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves from thee, be destroyed.
verses.modern: Moreover, the LORD Your God will send the hornet among them, until those who are left and hide themselves from You are destroyed.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them: for the LORD thy God is among you, a mighty God and terrible.
verses.modern: You shall not be in dread of them, for the LORD Your God is in Your midst, a great and awesome God.

verses.kjv: And the LORD thy God will put out those nations before thee by little and little: thou mayest not consume them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee.
verses.modern: The LORD Your God will clear away these nations before You little by little. You may not make an end of them at once, lest the wild beasts grow too numerous for You.

verses.kjv: But the LORD thy God shall deliver them unto thee, and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction, until they be destroyed.
verses.modern: But the LORD Your God will give them over to You and throw them into great confusion, until they are destroyed.

verses.kjv: And he shall deliver their kings into thine hand, and thou shalt destroy their name from under heaven: there shall no man be able to stand before thee, until thou have destroyed them.
verses.modern: he will give their kings into Your hand, and You shall make their name perish from under heaven. No one shall be able to stand against you until you have destroyed them.

verses.kjv: The graven images of their gods shall ye burn with fire: thou shalt not desire the silver or gold that is on them, nor take it unto thee, lest thou be snared therein: for it is an abomination to the LORD thy God.
verses.modern: The carved images of their gods You shall burn with fire. You shall not covet the silver or the gold that is on them or take it for yourselves, lest You be ensnared by it, for it is an abomination to the LORD Your God.

verses.kjv: Neither shalt thou bring an abomination into thine house, lest thou be a cursed thing like it: but thou shalt utterly detest it, and thou shalt utterly abhor it; for it is a cursed thing.
verses.modern: you shall not bring an abominable thing into Your house and become devoted to destruction like it. You shall utterly detest and abhor it, for it is devoted to destruction.

chapters.summary: Moses commands Israel to utterly destroy the seven nations of Canaan when they enter the land, making no covenants and no marriages with them. He assures them that the LORD has chosen Israel not because they are great in number but because He loves them and keeps His covenant.

verses.kjv: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers.
