verses.modern: "Cursed be anyone who dishonors his father or his mother." And all the people shall say, "Amen."

verses.kjv: Cursed be he that removeth his neighbour's landmark. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.modern: "Cursed be anyone who moves his neighbor's landmark." And all the people shall say, "Amen."

verses.kjv: Cursed be he that maketh the blind to wander out of the way. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.modern: "Cursed be anyone who misleads a blind man on the road." And all the people shall say, "Amen."

verses.kjv: Cursed be he that perverteth the judgment of the stranger, fatherless, and widow. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.modern: "Cursed be anyone who perverts the justice due to the sojourner, the fatherless, and the widow." And all the people shall say, "Amen."

verses.kjv: Cursed be he that lieth with his father's wife; because he uncovereth his father's skirt. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.modern: "Cursed be anyone who lies with his father's wife, because he has uncovered His father's nakedness." And all the people shall say, "Amen."

verses.kjv: Cursed be he that lieth with any manner of beast. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.modern: "Cursed be anyone who lies with any kind of animal." And all the people shall say, "Amen."

verses.kjv: Cursed be he that lieth with his sister, the daughter of his father, or the daughter of his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.modern: "Cursed be anyone who lies with his sister, whether the daughter of His father or the daughter of His mother." And all the people shall say, "Amen."

verses.kjv: Cursed be he that lieth with his mother in law. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.modern: "Cursed be anyone who lies with his mother-in-law." And all the people shall say, "Amen."

verses.kjv: Cursed be he that smiteth his neighbour secretly. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.modern: "Cursed be anyone who strikes down his neighbor in secret." And all the people shall say, "Amen."

verses.kjv: Cursed be he that taketh reward to slay an innocent person. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.modern: "Cursed be anyone who takes a bribe to shed innocent blood." And all the people shall say, "Amen."

verses.kjv: Cursed be he that confirmeth not all the words of this law to do them. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.modern: "Cursed be anyone who does not confirm the words of this law by doing them." And all the people shall say, "Amen."

chapters.summary: Moses and the elders command Israel to set up large plastered stones on Mount Ebal when they cross the Jordan and write the words of the law on them. Six tribes are to stand on Mount Gerizim to bless and six on Mount Ebal to curse, and the Levites pronounce twelve curses for specific sins, to which the people answer 'Amen.'

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe and to do all his commandments which I command thee this day, that the LORD thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth:
verses.modern: if You faithfully obey the voice of the LORD Your God, being careful to do all His commandments that I command You today, the LORD Your God will set You high above all the nations of the earth.

verses.kjv: And all these blessings shall come on thee, and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God.
verses.modern: all these blessings shall come upon You and overtake You, if You obey the voice of the LORD Your God.

verses.kjv: Blessed shalt thou be in the city, and blessed shalt thou be in the field.
verses.modern: Blessed shall You be in the city, and blessed shall You be in the field.

verses.kjv: Blessed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy ground, and the fruit of thy cattle, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.
verses.modern: Blessed shall be the fruit of Your womb and the fruit of Your ground and the fruit of Your cattle, the increase of Your herds and the young of Your flock.

verses.kjv: Blessed shall be thy basket and thy store.
verses.modern: Blessed shall be Your basket and Your kneading bowl.

verses.kjv: Blessed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and blessed shalt thou be when thou goest out.
verses.modern: Blessed shall You be when You come in, and blessed shall You be when You go out.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thy face: they shall come out against thee one way, and flee before thee seven ways.
verses.modern: The LORD will cause Your enemies who rise against You to be defeated before You. They shall come out against You one way and flee before You seven ways.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall command the blessing upon thee in thy storehouses, and in all that thou settest thine hand unto; and he shall bless thee in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
verses.modern: The LORD will command the blessing on You in Your barns and in all that You undertake. And He will bless You in the land that the LORD Your God is giving You.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall establish thee an holy people unto himself, as he hath sworn unto thee, if thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, and walk in his ways.
verses.modern: The LORD will establish You as a people holy to Himself, as He has sworn to You, if You keep the commandments of the LORD Your God and walk in His ways.

verses.kjv: And all people of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of the LORD; and they shall be afraid of thee.
verses.modern: all the peoples of the earth shall see that You are called by the name of the LORD. They shall be afraid of You.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shall make thee plenteous in goods, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy ground, in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers to give thee.
verses.modern: the LORD will make You abound in prosperity, in the fruit of Your womb and in the fruit of Your livestock and in the fruit of Your ground, within the land that the LORD swore to Your fathers to give You.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow.
verses.modern: The LORD will open to You His good treasury, the heavens, to give the rain to Your land in its season and to bless all the work of Your hands. And You shall lend to many nations, but You shall not borrow.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shall make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the LORD thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do them:
verses.modern: the LORD will make You the head and not the tail, and You shall only go up and not down, if You obey the commandments of the LORD Your God, which I command You today, being careful to do them,

verses.kjv: And thou shalt not go aside from any of the words which I command thee this day, to the right hand, or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
verses.modern: if You do not turn aside from any of the words that I command You today, to the right hand or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.

verses.kjv: But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee:
verses.modern: But if You will not obey the voice of the LORD Your God or be careful to do all His commandments and His statutes that I command You today, then all these curses shall come upon You and overtake You.

verses.kjv: Cursed shalt thou be in the city, and cursed shalt thou be in the field.
verses.modern: Cursed shall You be in the city, and cursed shall You be in the field.

verses.kjv: Cursed shall be thy basket and thy store.
verses.modern: Cursed shall be Your basket and Your kneading bowl.

verses.kjv: Cursed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy land, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.
verses.modern: Cursed shall be the fruit of Your womb and the fruit of Your ground, the increase of Your herds and the young of Your flock.

verses.kjv: Cursed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and cursed shalt thou be when thou goest out.
verses.modern: Cursed shall You be when You come in, and cursed shall You be when You go out.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall send upon thee cursing, vexation, and rebuke, in all that thou settest thine hand unto for to do, until thou be destroyed, and until thou perish quickly; because of the wickedness of thy doings, whereby thou hast forsaken me.
verses.modern: The LORD will send on You curses, confusion, and frustration in all that You undertake to do, until You are destroyed and perish quickly on account of the evil of Your deeds, because You have forsaken me.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall make the pestilence cleave unto thee, until he have consumed thee from off the land, whither thou goest to possess it.
verses.modern: The LORD will make the pestilence stick to You until He has consumed You off the land that You are entering to take possession of it.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall smite thee with a consumption, and with a fever, and with an inflammation, and with an extreme burning, and with the sword, and with blasting, and with mildew; and they shall pursue thee until thou perish.
verses.modern: The LORD will strike You with wasting disease and with fever, inflammation and fiery heat, and with drought and with blight and with mildew. They shall pursue You until You perish.

verses.kjv: And thy heaven that is over thy head shall be brass, and the earth that is under thee shall be iron.
verses.modern: the heavens over Your head shall be bronze, and the earth under You shall be iron.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall make the rain of thy land powder and dust: from heaven shall it come down upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
verses.modern: The LORD will make the rain of Your land powder and dust. From heaven it shall come down on You until You are destroyed.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall cause thee to be smitten before thine enemies: thou shalt go out one way against them, and flee seven ways before them: and shalt be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.modern: The LORD will cause You to be defeated before Your enemies. You shall go out one way against them and flee seven ways before them. And You shall be a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth.

verses.kjv: And thy carcase shall be meat unto all fowls of the air, and unto the beasts of the earth, and no man shall fray them away.
verses.modern: your dead body shall be food for all birds of the air and for the beasts of the earth, and there shall be no one to frighten them away.

verses.kjv: The LORD will smite thee with the botch of Egypt, and with the emerods, and with the scab, and with the itch, whereof thou canst not be healed.
verses.modern: The LORD will strike You with the boils of Egypt, and with tumors and scabs and itch, of which You cannot be healed.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart:
verses.modern: The LORD will strike You with madness and blindness and confusion of mind,

verses.kjv: And thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways: and thou shalt be only oppressed and spoiled evermore, and no man shall save thee.
verses.modern: you shall grope at noonday, as the blind grope in darkness, and You shall not prosper in Your ways. And You shall be only oppressed and robbed continually, and there shall be no one to help you.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her: thou shalt build an house, and thou shalt not dwell therein: thou shalt plant a vineyard, and shalt not gather the grapes thereof.
verses.modern: You shall betroth a wife, but another man shall ravish her. You shall build a house, but You shall not dwell in it. You shall plant a vineyard, but You shall not enjoy its fruit.

verses.kjv: Thine ox shall be slain before thine eyes, and thou shalt not eat thereof: thine ass shall be violently taken away from before thy face, and shall not be restored to thee: thy sheep shall be given unto thine enemies, and thou shalt have none to save thee.
verses.modern: Your ox shall be slaughtered before Your eyes, but You shall not eat any of it. Your donkey shall be seized before Your face and shall not be returned to You. Your sheep shall be given to Your enemies, and there shall be no one to help you.

verses.kjv: Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people, and thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long: and there shall be no might in thine hand.
verses.modern: Your sons and Your daughters shall be given to another people, while Your eyes look on and fail with longing for them all day long, but You shall be helpless.

verses.kjv: The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway:
verses.modern: A nation that You have not known shall eat up the fruit of Your ground and of all Your labors, and You shall be only oppressed and crushed continually,

verses.kjv: So that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
verses.modern: so that You are driven mad by the sights that Your eyes see.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall smite thee in the knees, and in the legs, with a sore botch that cannot be healed, from the sole of thy foot unto the top of thy head.
verses.modern: The LORD will strike You on the knees and on the legs with grievous boils of which You cannot be healed, from the sole of Your foot to the crown of Your head.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall bring thee, and thy king which thou shalt set over thee, unto a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers have known; and there shalt thou serve other gods, wood and stone.
verses.modern: The LORD will bring You and Your king whom You set over You to a nation that neither You nor Your fathers have known. And there You shall serve other gods of wood and stone.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations whither the LORD shall lead thee.
verses.modern: you shall become a horror, a proverb, and a byword among all the peoples where the LORD will lead You away.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt carry much seed out into the field, and shalt gather but little in; for the locust shall consume it.
verses.modern: You shall carry much seed into the field and shall gather in little, for the locust shall consume it.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt plant vineyards, and dress them, but shalt neither drink of the wine, nor gather the grapes; for the worms shall eat them.
verses.modern: You shall plant vineyards and dress them, but You shall neither drink of the wine nor gather the grapes, for the worm shall eat them.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt have olive trees throughout all thy coasts, but thou shalt not anoint thyself with the oil; for thine olive shall cast his fruit.
verses.modern: You shall have olive trees throughout all Your territory, but You shall not anoint Yourself with the oil, for Your olives shall drop off.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but thou shalt not enjoy them; for they shall go into captivity.
verses.modern: You shall father sons and daughters. But they shall not be Yours, for they shall go into captivity.

verses.kjv: All thy trees and fruit of thy land shall the locust consume.
verses.modern: The cricket shall possess all Your trees and the fruit of Your ground.

verses.kjv: The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high; and thou shalt come down very low.
verses.modern: The sojourner who is among You shall rise higher and higher above You, and You shall come down lower and lower.

verses.kjv: He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.
verses.modern: He shall lend to You, and You shall not lend to Him. He shall be the head, and You shall be the tail.

verses.kjv: Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded thee:
verses.modern: All these curses shall come upon You and pursue You and overtake You till You are destroyed, because You did not obey the voice of the LORD Your God, to keep His commandments and His statutes that He commanded You.

verses.kjv: And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.
verses.modern: They shall be a sign and a wonder against You and Your seed forever.

verses.kjv: Because thou servedst not the LORD thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all things;
verses.modern: Because You did not serve the LORD Your God with joyfulness and gladness of heart, because of the abundance of all things,

verses.kjv: Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the LORD shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.
verses.modern: therefore You shall serve Your enemies whom the LORD will send against You, in hunger and thirst, in nakedness, and lacking everything. And He will put a yoke of iron on Your neck until He has destroyed You.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall bring a nation against thee from far, from the end of the earth, as swift as the eagle flieth; a nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand;
verses.modern: The LORD will bring a nation against You from far away, from the end of the earth, swooping down like the eagle, a nation whose language You do not understand,

verses.kjv: A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old, nor shew favour to the young:
verses.modern: a hard-faced nation who shall not respect the old or show mercy to the young.

verses.kjv: And he shall eat the fruit of thy cattle, and the fruit of thy land, until thou be destroyed: which also shall not leave thee either corn, wine, or oil, or the increase of thy kine, or flocks of thy sheep, until he have destroyed thee.
verses.modern: It shall eat the seed of Your cattle and the fruit of Your ground, until You are destroyed; it also shall not leave You grain, wine, or oil, the increase of Your herds or the young of Your flock, until they have caused You to perish.

verses.kjv: And he shall besiege thee in all thy gates, until thy high and fenced walls come down, wherein thou trustedst, throughout all thy land: and he shall besiege thee in all thy gates throughout all thy land, which the LORD thy God hath given thee.
verses.modern: They shall besiege You in all Your towns, until Your high and fortified walls, in which You trusted, come down throughout all Your land. And they shall besiege You in all Your towns throughout all Your land, which the LORD Your God has given You.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt eat the fruit of thine own body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters, which the LORD thy God hath given thee, in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee:
verses.modern: you shall eat the fruit of Your womb, the flesh of Your sons and daughters, whom the LORD Your God has given You, in the siege and in the distress with which Your enemies shall distress You.

verses.kjv: So that the man that is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye shall be evil toward his brother, and toward the wife of his bosom, and toward the remnant of his children which he shall leave:
verses.modern: The man who is the most tender and refined among you will begrudge food to his brother, to the wife he embraces, and to the last of the children whom he has left,

verses.kjv: So that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he shall eat: because he hath nothing left him in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee in all thy gates.
verses.modern: so that he will not give to any of them any of the flesh of his children whom he is eating, because he has nothing else left, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy shall distress you in all your towns.

verses.kjv: The tender and delicate woman among you, which would not adventure to set the sole of her foot upon the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye shall be evil toward the husband of her bosom, and toward her son, and toward her daughter,
verses.modern: The most tender and refined woman among you, who would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground because she is so delicate and tender, will begrudge to the husband she embraces, to her son and to her daughter,

verses.kjv: And toward her young one that cometh out from between her feet, and toward her children which she shall bear: for she shall eat them for want of all things secretly in the siege and straitness, wherewith thine enemy shall distress thee in thy gates.
verses.modern: her afterbirth that comes out from between her feet and her children whom she bears, because lacking everything she will eat them secretly, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy shall distress you in your towns.

verses.kjv: If thou wilt not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that thou mayest fear this glorious and fearful name, THE LORD THY GOD;
verses.modern: If You are not careful to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that You may fear this glorious and awesome name, the LORD Your God,

verses.kjv: Then the LORD will make thy plagues wonderful, and the plagues of thy seed, even great plagues, and of long continuance, and sore sicknesses, and of long continuance.
verses.modern: then the LORD will bring on You and Your seed extraordinary afflictions, afflictions severe and lasting, and sicknesses grievous and lasting.

verses.kjv: Moreover he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt, which thou wast afraid of; and they shall cleave unto thee.
verses.modern: he will bring upon You again all the diseases of Egypt, of which You were afraid. They shall cling to You.

verses.kjv: Also every sickness, and every plague, which is not written in the book of this law, them will the LORD bring upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
verses.modern: Every sickness also and every affliction that is not recorded in the book of this law, the LORD will bring upon You, until You are destroyed.

verses.kjv: And ye shall be left few in number, whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude; because thou wouldest not obey the voice of the LORD thy God.
verses.modern: Whereas You were as numerous as the stars of heaven, You shall be left few in number, because You did not obey the voice of the LORD Your God.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that as the LORD rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you; so the LORD will rejoice over you to destroy you, and to bring you to nought; and ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest to possess it.
verses.modern: as the LORD took delight in doing You good and multiplying You, so the LORD will take delight in bringing ruin upon You and destroying You. And You shall be plucked off the land that You are entering to take possession of it.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, even wood and stone.
verses.modern: the LORD will scatter You among all peoples, from one end of the earth to the other, and there You shall serve other gods of wood and stone, which neither You nor Your fathers have known.

verses.kjv: And among these nations shalt thou find no ease, neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest: but the LORD shall give thee there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and sorrow of mind:
verses.modern: among these nations You shall find no respite, and there shall be no resting place for the sole of Your foot, but the LORD will give You there a trembling heart and failing eyes and a languishing soul.

verses.kjv: And thy life shall hang in doubt before thee; and thou shalt fear day and night, and shalt have none assurance of thy life:
verses.modern: Your life shall hang in doubt before You. Night and day You shall be in dread and have no assurance of Your life.

verses.kjv: In the morning thou shalt say, Would God it were even! and at even thou shalt say, Would God it were morning! for the fear of thine heart wherewith thou shalt fear, and for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
verses.modern: In the morning You shall say, "If only it were evening!" and at evening You shall say, "If only it were morning!" because of the dread that Your heart shall feel, and the sights that Your eyes shall see.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships, by the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again: and there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy you.
verses.modern: the LORD will bring You back in ships to Egypt, a journey that I promised that You should never make again. There You shall offer yourselves for sale to Your enemies as male and female slaves, but there will be no buyer.

chapters.summary: Moses pronounces blessings for obedience -- prosperity, victory, and honor among the nations -- and curses for disobedience -- disease, drought, defeat, madness, and exile. The curses grow in severity, climaxing in siege, cannibalism, and the scattering of Israel among all nations from one end of the earth to the other.

verses.kjv: These are the words of the covenant, which the LORD commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, beside the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.
verses.modern: These are the words of the covenant that the LORD commanded Moses to make with the people of Israel in the land of Moab, besides the covenant that He had made with them at Horeb.

verses.kjv: And Moses called unto all Israel, and said unto them, Ye have seen all that the LORD did before your eyes in the land of Egypt unto Pharaoh, and unto all his servants, and unto all his land;
verses.modern: Moses summoned all Israel and said to them: "You have seen all that the LORD did before Your eyes in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh and to all his servants and to all his land,

verses.kjv: The great temptations which thine eyes have seen, the signs, and those great miracles:
verses.modern: the great trials that Your eyes saw, the signs, and those great wonders.

verses.kjv: Yet the LORD hath not given you an heart to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day.
verses.modern: But to this day the LORD has not given You a heart to understand or eyes to see or ears to hear.

verses.kjv: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your clothes are not waxen old upon you, and thy shoe is not waxen old upon thy foot.
verses.modern: I have led You forty years in the wilderness. Your clothes have not worn out on You, and Your sandals have not worn off Your feet.

verses.kjv: Ye have not eaten bread, neither have ye drunk wine or strong drink: that ye might know that I am the LORD your God.
verses.modern: You have not eaten bread, and You have not drunk wine or strong drink, that You may know that I am the LORD Your God.

verses.kjv: And when ye came unto this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, came out against us unto battle, and we smote them:
verses.modern: when you came to this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon and Og the king of Bashan came out against us to battle. But we defeated them.

verses.kjv: And we took their land, and gave it for an inheritance unto the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half tribe of Manasseh.
verses.modern: We took their land and gave it for an inheritance to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

verses.kjv: Keep therefore the words of this covenant, and do them, that ye may prosper in all that ye do.
verses.modern: Therefore keep the words of this covenant and do them, that you may prosper in all that you do.

verses.kjv: Ye stand this day all of you before the LORD your God; your captains of your tribes, your elders, and your officers, with all the men of Israel,
verses.modern: You are standing today, all of You, before the LORD Your God: the heads of Your tribes, Your elders, and Your officers, all the men of Israel,

verses.kjv: Your little ones, your wives, and thy stranger that is in thy camp, from the hewer of thy wood unto the drawer of thy water:
verses.modern: your little ones, Your wives, and the sojourner who is in Your camp, from the one who chops your wood to the one who draws your water,

verses.kjv: That thou shouldest enter into covenant with the LORD thy God, and into his oath, which the LORD thy God maketh with thee this day:
verses.modern: so that You may enter into the sworn covenant of the LORD Your God, which the LORD Your God is making with You today,

verses.kjv: That he may establish thee to day for a people unto himself, and that he may be unto thee a God, as he hath said unto thee, and as he hath sworn unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
verses.modern: that he may establish you today as his people, and that he may be your God, as He promised you, and as He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

verses.kjv: Neither with you only do I make this covenant and this oath;
verses.modern: It is not with you alone that I am making this sworn covenant,

verses.kjv: But with him that standeth here with us this day before the LORD our God, and also with him that is not here with us this day:
verses.modern: but with whoever is standing here with us today before the LORD our God, and with whoever is not here with us today.

verses.kjv: (For ye know how we have dwelt in the land of Egypt; and how we came through the nations which ye passed by;
verses.modern: For You know how we lived in the land of Egypt, and how we came through the midst of the nations through which you passed.

verses.kjv: And ye have seen their abominations, and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which were among them:)
verses.modern: you have seen their detestable things, their idols of wood and stone, of silver and gold, which were among them.)

verses.kjv: Lest there should be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turneth away this day from the LORD our God, to go and serve the gods of these nations; lest there should be among you a root that beareth gall and wormwood;
verses.modern: Beware lest there be among You a man or woman or clan or tribe whose heart is turning away today from the LORD our God to go and serve the gods of those nations. Beware lest there be among You a root bearing poisonous and bitter fruit,

verses.kjv: And it come to pass, when he heareth the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, I shall have peace, though I walk in the imagination of mine heart, to add drunkenness to thirst:
verses.modern: one who, when He hears the words of this sworn covenant, blesses Himself in His heart, saying, "I shall be safe, though I walk in the stubbornness of my heart." This will lead to adding drunkenness to thirst.

verses.kjv: The LORD will not spare him, but then the anger of the LORD and his jealousy shall smoke against that man, and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie upon him, and the LORD shall blot out his name from under heaven.
verses.modern: The LORD will not be willing to forgive Him, but rather the anger of the LORD and His jealousy will smoke against that man, and the curses written in this book will settle on Him. The LORD will blot out His name from under heaven.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shall separate him unto evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this book of the law:
verses.modern: the LORD will single Him out from all the tribes of Israel for calamity, in accordance with all the curses of the covenant written in this Book of the Law.

verses.kjv: So that the generation to come of your children that shall rise up after you, and the stranger that shall come from a far land, shall say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses which the LORD hath laid upon it;
verses.modern: the next generation, Your children who rise up after You, and the foreigner who comes from a far land, will say, when they see the afflictions of that land and the sicknesses with which the LORD has made it sick—

verses.kjv: And that the whole land thereof is brimstone, and salt, and burning, that it is not sown, nor beareth, nor any grass groweth therein, like the overthrow of Sodom, and Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboim, which the LORD overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath:
verses.modern: the whole land burned out with brimstone and salt, nothing sown and nothing growing, where no plant grows, like the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim, which the LORD overthrew in His anger and wrath—

verses.kjv: Even all nations shall say, Wherefore hath the LORD done thus unto this land? what meaneth the heat of this great anger?
verses.modern: all the nations will say, "Why has the LORD done thus to this land? What caused the heat of this great anger?"

verses.kjv: Then men shall say, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt:
verses.modern: Then people will say, "It is because they abandoned the covenant of the LORD, the God of their fathers, which He made with them when He brought them out of the land of Egypt,

verses.kjv: For they went and served other gods, and worshipped them, gods whom they knew not, and whom he had not given unto them:
verses.modern: went and served other gods and worshiped them, gods whom they had not known and whom He had not allotted to them.

verses.kjv: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against this land, to bring upon it all the curses that are written in this book:
verses.modern: Therefore the anger of the LORD was kindled against this land, bringing upon it all the curses written in this book,

verses.kjv: And the LORD rooted them out of their land in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation, and cast them into another land, as it is this day.
verses.modern: the LORD uprooted them from their land in anger and fury and great wrath, and cast them into another land, as they are today."

verses.kjv: The secret things belong unto the LORD our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.
verses.modern: The secret things belong to the LORD our God, but the things that are revealed belong to us and to our children forever, that we may do all the words of this law.

chapters.summary: Moses makes a covenant with Israel in Moab, in addition to the one at Horeb, rehearsing the LORD's mighty acts in Egypt and the wilderness. He warns that the LORD's anger will burn against anyone who secretly turns to idolatry, and declares that the secret things belong to the LORD but the revealed things belong to Israel and their children forever.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon thee, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before thee, and thou shalt call them to mind among all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath driven thee,
verses.modern: when all these things come upon You, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before You, and You call them to mind among all the nations where the LORD Your God has driven You,

verses.kjv: And shalt return unto the LORD thy God, and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day, thou and thy children, with all thine heart, and with all thy soul;
verses.modern: return to the LORD Your God, You and Your children, and obey His voice in all that I command You today, with all Your heart and with all Your soul,

verses.kjv: That then the LORD thy God will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath scattered thee.
verses.modern: then the LORD Your God will restore Your fortunes and have mercy on You. He will gather You again from all the peoples where the LORD Your God has scattered You.

verses.kjv: If any of thine be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven, from thence will the LORD thy God gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee:
verses.modern: If Your outcasts are in the uttermost parts of heaven, from there the LORD Your God will gather You, and from there He will take You.

verses.kjv: And the LORD thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed, and thou shalt possess it; and he will do thee good, and multiply thee above thy fathers.
verses.modern: the LORD Your God will bring You into the land that Your fathers possessed, that You may possess it. And He will make You more prosperous and numerous than Your fathers.

verses.kjv: And the LORD thy God will circumcise thine heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.
verses.modern: the LORD Your God will circumcise Your heart and the heart of Your seed, so that You will love the LORD Your God with all Your heart and with all Your soul, that You may live.

verses.kjv: And the LORD thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies, and on them that hate thee, which persecuted thee.
verses.modern: the LORD Your God will put all these curses on Your foes and enemies who persecuted You.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt return and obey the voice of the LORD, and do all his commandments which I command thee this day.
verses.modern: you shall again obey the voice of the LORD and keep all His commandments that I command You today.

verses.kjv: And the LORD thy God will make thee plenteous in every work of thine hand, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy land, for good: for the LORD will again rejoice over thee for good, as he rejoiced over thy fathers:
verses.modern: The LORD Your God will make You abundantly prosperous in all the work of Your hand, in the fruit of Your womb and in the fruit of Your cattle and in the fruit of Your ground. For the LORD will again take delight in prospering You, as He took delight in Your fathers,

verses.kjv: If thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, and if thou turn unto the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.
verses.modern: when You obey the voice of the LORD Your God, to keep His commandments and His statutes that are written in this Book of the Law, when You turn to the LORD Your God with all Your heart and with all Your soul.

verses.kjv: For this commandment which I command thee this day, it is not hidden from thee, neither is it far off.
verses.modern: For this commandment that I command You today is not too hard for You, neither is it far off.

verses.kjv: It is not in heaven, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go up for us to heaven, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?
verses.modern: It is not in heaven, that You should say, "Who will ascend to heaven for us and bring it to us, that we may hear it and do it?"

verses.kjv: Neither is it beyond the sea, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go over the sea for us, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?
verses.modern: Neither is it beyond the sea, that You should say, "Who will go over the sea for us and bring it to us, that we may hear it and do it?"

verses.kjv: But the word is very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.
verses.modern: But the word is very near You. It is in Your mouth and in Your heart, so that You can do it.

verses.kjv: See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil;
verses.modern: See, I have set before You today life and good, death and evil.

verses.kjv: In that I command thee this day to love the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments, that thou mayest live and multiply: and the LORD thy God shall bless thee in the land whither thou goest to possess it.
verses.modern: If You obey the commandments of the LORD Your God that I command You today, by loving the LORD Your God, by walking in His ways, and by keeping His commandments and His statutes and His rules, then You shall live and multiply. The LORD Your God will bless You in the land that You are entering to take possession of it.

verses.kjv: But if thine heart turn away, so that thou wilt not hear, but shalt be drawn away, and worship other gods, and serve them;
verses.modern: But if Your heart turns away, and You will not hear, but are drawn away to worship other gods and serve them,

verses.kjv: I denounce unto you this day, that ye shall surely perish, and that ye shall not prolong your days upon the land, whither thou passest over Jordan to go to possess it.
verses.modern: I declare to You today, that You shall surely perish. You shall not live long in the land that You are going over the Jordan to enter and possess.

verses.kjv: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live:
verses.modern: I call heaven and earth to witness against You today, that I have set before You life and death, blessing and curse. Therefore choose life, that You and Your seed may live,

verses.kjv: That thou mayest love the LORD thy God, and that thou mayest obey his voice, and that thou mayest cleave unto him: for he is thy life, and the length of thy days: that thou mayest dwell in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.
verses.modern: loving the LORD Your God, obeying His voice and holding fast to Him, for He is Your life and length of days, that You may dwell in the land that the LORD swore to Your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.

chapters.summary: Moses promises that when Israel returns to the LORD after exile, He will gather them from all the nations and circumcise their hearts to love Him. He sets before them life and death, blessing and cursing, and calls heaven and earth as witnesses, urging them to choose life.

verses.kjv: And Moses went and spake these words unto all Israel.
verses.modern: So Moses continued speaking these words to all Israel.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, I am an hundred and twenty years old this day; I can no more go out and come in: also the LORD hath said unto me, Thou shalt not go over this Jordan.
verses.modern: he said to them, "I am 120 years old today. I am no longer able to go out and come in. The LORD has said to me, 'You shall not go over this Jordan.'

verses.kjv: The LORD thy God, he will go over before thee, and he will destroy these nations from before thee, and thou shalt possess them: and Joshua, he shall go over before thee, as the LORD hath said.
verses.modern: The LORD Your God Himself will go over before You. He will destroy these nations before You, so that You shall dispossess them, and Joshua will go over before you, as the LORD has spoken.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shall do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and unto the land of them, whom he destroyed.
verses.modern: the LORD will do to them as He did to Sihon and Og, the kings of the Amorites, and to their land, when He destroyed them.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shall give them up before your face, that ye may do unto them according unto all the commandments which I have commanded you.
verses.modern: the LORD will give them over to You, and You shall do to them according to the whole commandment that I have commanded You.

verses.kjv: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the LORD thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
verses.modern: Be strong and courageous. Do not fear or be in dread of them, for it is the LORD Your God Who goes with You. He will not leave You or forsake You."

verses.kjv: And Moses called unto Joshua, and said unto him in the sight of all Israel, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou must go with this people unto the land which the LORD hath sworn unto their fathers to give them; and thou shalt cause them to inherit it.
verses.modern: Then Moses summoned Joshua and said to him in the sight of all Israel, "Be strong and courageous, for You shall go with this people into the land that the LORD has sworn to their fathers to give them, and You shall put them in possession of it.

verses.kjv: And the LORD, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.
verses.modern: It is the LORD Who goes before You. He will be with You; He will not leave You or forsake You. Do not fear or be dismayed."

verses.kjv: And Moses wrote this law, and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and unto all the elders of Israel.
verses.modern: Then Moses wrote this law and gave it to the priests, the sons of Levi, who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and to all the elders of Israel.

verses.kjv: And Moses commanded them, saying, At the end of every seven years, in the solemnity of the year of release, in the feast of tabernacles,
verses.modern: Moses commanded them, "At the end of every seven years, at the set time in the year of release, at the feast of tabernacles,

verses.kjv: When all Israel is come to appear before the LORD thy God in the place which he shall choose, thou shalt read this law before all Israel in their hearing.
verses.modern: when all Israel comes to appear before the LORD Your God at the place that He will choose, You shall read this law before all Israel in their hearing.

verses.kjv: Gather the people together, men, and women, and children, and thy stranger that is within thy gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear the LORD your God, and observe to do all the words of this law:
verses.modern: Assemble the people, men, women, and little ones, and the sojourner within Your towns, that they may hear and learn to fear the LORD Your God, and be careful to do all the words of this law,

verses.kjv: And that their children, which have not known any thing, may hear, and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as ye live in the land whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.
verses.modern: that their children, who have not known it, may hear and learn to fear the LORD Your God, as long as You live in the land that You are going over the Jordan to possess."

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thy days approach that thou must die: call Joshua, and present yourselves in the tabernacle of the congregation, that I may give him a charge. And Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.modern: The LORD said to Moses, 'The days approach when you must die. Call Joshua and present yourselves in the tent of meeting, that I may give Him a charge.' And Moses and Joshua went and presented themselves in the tent of meeting.

verses.kjv: And the LORD appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud: and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle.
verses.modern: the LORD appeared in the tent in a pillar of cloud. And the pillar of cloud stood over the entrance of the tent.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thou shalt sleep with thy fathers; and this people will rise up, and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land, whither they go to be among them, and will forsake me, and break my covenant which I have made with them.
verses.modern: The LORD said to Moses, 'You are about to lie down with your fathers. Then this people will rise and whore after the foreign gods among them in the land that they are entering. They will forsake me and break my covenant that I have made with them.

verses.kjv: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall befall them; so that they will say in that day, Are not these evils come upon us, because our God is not among us?
verses.modern: Then my anger will be kindled against them in that day. I will forsake them and hide my face from them. They will be devoured. And many evils and troubles will come upon them, so that they will say in that day, 'Have not these evils come upon us because our God is not among us?'

verses.kjv: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evils which they shall have wrought, in that they are turned unto other gods.
verses.modern: I will surely hide my face in that day because of all the evil that they have done, because they have turned to other gods.

verses.kjv: Now therefore write ye this song for you, and teach it the children of Israel: put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.
verses.modern: Now therefore write this song and teach it to the people of Israel. Put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I sware unto their fathers, that floweth with milk and honey; and they shall have eaten and filled themselves, and waxen fat; then will they turn unto other gods, and serve them, and provoke me, and break my covenant.
verses.modern: For when I have brought them into the land flowing with milk and honey, which I swore to give to their fathers. They have eaten and are full and grown fat, they will turn to other gods and serve them, and despise me and break my covenant.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when many evils and troubles are befallen them, that this song shall testify against them as a witness; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed: for I know their imagination which they go about, even now, before I have brought them into the land which I sware.
verses.modern: when many evils and troubles have come upon them, this song shall confront them as a witness (for it will live unforgotten in the mouths of their seed). For I know what they are inclined to do even today, before I have brought them into the land that I swore to give.

verses.kjv: Moses therefore wrote this song the same day, and taught it the children of Israel.
verses.modern: Moses therefore wrote this song the same day and taught it to the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge, and said, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou shalt bring the children of Israel into the land which I sware unto them: and I will be with thee.
verses.modern: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge, and said, "Be strong and courageous, for you shall bring the people of Israel into the land that I swore to give them. I will be with you."

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,
verses.modern: When Moses had finished writing the words of this law in a book to the very end,

verses.kjv: That Moses commanded the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, saying,
verses.modern: Moses commanded the Levites who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD,

verses.kjv: Take this book of the law, and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, that it may be there for a witness against thee.
verses.modern: "Take this Book of the Law and put it by the side of the ark of the covenant of the LORD Your God, that it may be there for a witness against You.

verses.kjv: For I know thy rebellion, and thy stiff neck: behold, while I am yet alive with you this day, ye have been rebellious against the LORD; and how much more after my death?
verses.modern: For I know how rebellious and stubborn You are. Even today while I am yet alive with You, You have been rebellious against the LORD. How much more after my death!

verses.kjv: Gather unto me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to record against them.
verses.modern: Assemble to me all the elders of Your tribes and Your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears and call heaven and earth to witness against them.

verses.kjv: For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will befall you in the latter days; because ye will do evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.
verses.modern: For I know that after my death You will surely act corruptly and turn aside from the way that I have commanded You. And in the days to come, evil will befall You, because You will do what is evil in the sight of the LORD, provoking Him to anger through the work of Your hands."

verses.kjv: And Moses spake in the ears of all the congregation of Israel the words of this song, until they were ended.
verses.modern: Then Moses spoke the words of this song until they were finished, in the ears of all the assembly of Israel:

chapters.summary: Moses, now 120 years old, tells Israel he can no longer go out and come in, and commissions Joshua before all the people. He writes the law and commands the Levites to read it to all Israel every seven years at the Feast of Tabernacles. The LORD tells Moses that Israel will break the covenant after his death.

verses.kjv: Give ear, O ye heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.
verses.modern: Give ear, O heavens. I will speak, and let the earth hear the words of my mouth.

verses.kjv: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass:
verses.modern: May my teaching drop as the rain, my speech distill as the dew, like gentle rain upon the tender grass, and like showers upon the herb.

verses.kjv: Because I will publish the name of the LORD: ascribe ye greatness unto our God.
verses.modern: For I will proclaim the name of the LORD; ascribe greatness to our God!

verses.kjv: He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he.
verses.modern: The Rock, His work is perfect, for all His ways are justice. A God of faithfulness and without iniquity, just and upright is He.

verses.kjv: They have corrupted themselves, their spot is not the spot of his children: they are a perverse and crooked generation.
verses.modern: They have dealt corruptly with Him; their spot is not the spot of His children; they are a crooked and twisted generation.

verses.kjv: Do ye thus requite the LORD, O foolish people and unwise? is not he thy father that hath bought thee? hath he not made thee, and established thee?
verses.modern: Do You thus repay the LORD, You foolish and senseless people? Is not He Your father, who created You, who made You and established You?

verses.kjv: Remember the days of old, consider the years of many generations: ask thy father, and he will shew thee; thy elders, and they will tell thee.
verses.modern: Remember the days of old; consider the years of many generations; ask Your father. He will show You, Your elders. They will tell You.

verses.kjv: When the Most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel.
verses.modern: When the Most High gave to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he fixed the borders of the peoples according to the number of the children of Israel.

verses.kjv: For the LORD's portion is his people; Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.
verses.modern: But the LORD's portion is His people, Jacob his allotted heritage.

verses.kjv: He found him in a desert land, and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him, he kept him as the apple of his eye.
verses.modern: He found Him in a desert land, and in the howling waste of the wilderness; He encircled Him, He cared for Him, He kept Him as the apple of His eye.

verses.kjv: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them on her wings:
verses.modern: Like an eagle that stirs up its nest, that flutters over its young, spreading out its wings, catching them, bearing them on its pinions,

verses.kjv: So the LORD alone did lead him, and there was no strange god with him.
verses.modern: the LORD alone guided Him, no foreign god was with Him.

verses.kjv: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, that he might eat the increase of the fields; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock;
verses.modern: He made Him ride on the high places of the land. He ate the produce of the field. He suckled Him with honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock.

verses.kjv: Butter of kine, and milk of sheep, with fat of lambs, and rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the fat of kidneys of wheat; and thou didst drink the pure blood of the grape.
verses.modern: Curds from the herd, and milk from the flock, with fat of lambs, rams of Bashan and goats, with the finest of the wheat—and You drank foaming wine made from the blood of the grape.

verses.kjv: But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: thou art waxen fat, thou art grown thick, thou art covered with fatness; then he forsook God which made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.
verses.modern: But Jeshurun grew fat and kicked; You grew fat, stout, and sleek; then He forsook God Who made Him and scoffed at the Rock of His salvation.

verses.kjv: They provoked him to jealousy with strange gods, with abominations provoked they him to anger.
verses.modern: They stirred Him to jealousy with strange gods; with abominations they provoked Him to anger.

verses.kjv: They sacrificed unto devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new gods that came newly up, whom your fathers feared not.
verses.modern: They sacrificed to demons that were no gods, to gods they had never known, to new gods that had come recently, whom Your fathers had never dreaded.

verses.kjv: Of the Rock that begat thee thou art unmindful, and hast forgotten God that formed thee.
verses.modern: You were unmindful of the Rock that bore You, and You forgot the God Who gave You birth.

verses.kjv: And when the LORD saw it, he abhorred them, because of the provoking of his sons, and of his daughters.
verses.modern: The LORD saw it and spurned them, because of the provocation of His sons and His daughters.

verses.kjv: And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end shall be: for they are a very froward generation, children in whom is no faith.
verses.modern: he said, "I will hide my face from them; I will see what their end will be, for they are a perverse generation, children in whom is no faithfulness.

verses.kjv: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities: and I will move them to jealousy with those which are not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.
verses.modern: They have made me jealous with what is no god; they have provoked me to anger with their idols. So I will make them jealous with those who are no people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.

verses.kjv: For a fire is kindled in mine anger, and shall burn unto the lowest hell, and shall consume the earth with her increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains.
verses.modern: For a fire is kindled by my anger. It burns to the depths of hell, devours the earth and its increase, and sets on fire the foundations of the mountains.

verses.kjv: I will heap mischiefs upon them; I will spend mine arrows upon them.
verses.modern: I will heap disasters upon them; I will spend my arrows against them;

verses.kjv: They shall be burnt with hunger, and devoured with burning heat, and with bitter destruction: I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them, with the poison of serpents of the dust.
verses.modern: they shall be wasted with hunger, and devoured by plague and poisonous pestilence; I will send the teeth of beasts against them, with the venom of things that crawl in the dust.

verses.kjv: The sword without, and terror within, shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, the suckling also with the man of gray hairs.
verses.modern: Outdoors the sword shall bereave, and indoors terror, for the young man and the young woman, the nursing child with the man of gray hairs.

verses.kjv: I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men:
verses.modern: I would have said, "I will cut them to pieces; I will wipe them from human memory,"

verses.kjv: Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy, lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely, and lest they should say, Our hand is high, and the LORD hath not done all this.
verses.modern: had I not feared provocation by the enemy, lest their adversaries should misunderstand, lest they should say, "Our hand is triumphant, it was not the LORD Who did all this."

verses.kjv: For they are a nation void of counsel, neither is there any understanding in them.
verses.modern: For they are a nation void of counsel, and there is no understanding in them.

verses.kjv: O that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!
verses.modern: If they were wise, they would understand this; they would discern their latter end!

verses.kjv: How should one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, except their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had shut them up?
verses.modern: How could one have chased a thousand, and two have put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had shut them up?

verses.kjv: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves being judges.
verses.modern: For their rock is not as our Rock; our enemies themselves being judges.

verses.kjv: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, and of the fields of Gomorrah: their grapes are grapes of gall, their clusters are bitter:
verses.modern: For their vine comes from the vine of Sodom and from the fields of Gomorrah; their grapes are grapes of poison; their clusters are bitter;

verses.kjv: Their wine is the poison of dragons, and the cruel venom of asps.
verses.modern: their wine is the poison of serpents and the cruel venom of asps.

verses.kjv: Is not this laid up in store with me, and sealed up among my treasures?
verses.modern: Is not this laid up in store with me, sealed up in my treasuries?

verses.kjv: To me belongeth vengeance, and recompence; their foot shall slide in due time: for the day of their calamity is at hand, and the things that shall come upon them make haste.
verses.modern: Vengeance is mine, and recompense, for the time when their foot shall slip; for the day of their calamity is at hand. Their doom comes swiftly.

verses.kjv: For the LORD shall judge his people, and repent himself for his servants, when he seeth that their power is gone, and there is none shut up, or left.
verses.modern: For the LORD will vindicate His people and have compassion on His servants, when he sees that their power is gone and there is none remaining, bond or free.

verses.kjv: And he shall say, Where are their gods, their rock in whom they trusted,
verses.modern: Then He will say, "Where are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge,

verses.kjv: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offerings? let them rise up and help you, and be your protection.
verses.modern: who ate the fat of their sacrifices and drank the wine of their drink offering? Let them rise up and help You; let them be Your protection!

verses.kjv: See now that I, even I, am he, and there is no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal: neither is there any that can deliver out of my hand.
verses.modern: See now that I, even I, am He, and there is no god beside me; I kill and I make alive; I wound and I heal. There is none that can deliver out of my hand.

verses.kjv: For I lift up my hand to heaven, and say, I live for ever.
verses.modern: For I lift up my hand to heaven and swear, As I live forever,

verses.kjv: If I whet my glittering sword, and mine hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance to mine enemies, and will reward them that hate me.
verses.modern: if I sharpen my flashing sword and my hand takes hold on judgment, I will take vengeance on my adversaries and will repay those who hate me.

verses.kjv: I will make mine arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall devour flesh; and that with the blood of the slain and of the captives, from the beginning of revenges upon the enemy.
verses.modern: I will make my arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall devour flesh—with the blood of the slain and the captives, from the beginning of revenges upon the enemy."

verses.kjv: Rejoice, O ye nations, with his people: for he will avenge the blood of his servants, and will render vengeance to his adversaries, and will be merciful unto his land, and to his people.
verses.modern: Rejoice, O nations, with His people, for He will avenge the blood of His servants and render vengeance to his adversaries, and will be merciful to His land and to His people.

verses.kjv: And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun.
verses.modern: Moses came and recited all the words of this song in the hearing of the people, he and Joshua the son of Nun.

verses.kjv: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel:
verses.modern: when Moses had finished speaking all these words to all Israel,

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day, which ye shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.
verses.modern: he said to them, "Take to heart all the words by which I am warning you today, that you may command them to your children, that they may be careful to do all the words of this law.

verses.kjv: For it is not a vain thing for you; because it is your life: and through this thing ye shall prolong your days in the land, whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.
verses.modern: For it is no empty word for you, but your very life, and by this word you shall live long in the land that you are going over the Jordan to possess."

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses that selfsame day, saying,
verses.modern: the LORD spoke to Moses that same day, saying,

verses.kjv: Get thee up into this mountain Abarim, unto mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is over against Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession:
verses.modern: "Go up this mountain of the Abarim, Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, opposite Jericho, and view the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the people of Israel for a possession.

verses.kjv: And die in the mount whither thou goest up, and be gathered unto thy people; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor, and was gathered unto his people:
verses.modern: die on the mountain that you go up, and be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother died on Mount Hor and was gathered to his people,

verses.kjv: Because ye trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah-Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because ye sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Israel.
verses.modern: because you broke faith with me in the midst of the people of Israel at the waters of Meribah-kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin, and because you did not treat me as holy in the midst of the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: Yet thou shalt see the land before thee; but thou shalt not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Israel.
verses.modern: For you shall see the land before you, but you shall not go there, into the land that I am giving to the people of Israel."

chapters.summary: Moses recites the Song of Moses before all Israel, declaring God's faithfulness and Israel's future unfaithfulness. The song recounts how the LORD found Israel in the wilderness and carried them, how they grew fat and forsook Him, and how He will vindicate His people in the end. Afterward the LORD tells Moses to go up Mount Nebo to die.

verses.kjv: And this is the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.
verses.modern: This is the blessing with which Moses the man of God blessed the people of Israel before his death.

verses.kjv: And he said, The LORD came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand went a fiery law for them.
verses.modern: He said, "The LORD came from Sinai and dawned from Seir upon us; He shone forth from Mount Paran; He came from the ten thousands of holy ones, with flaming fire at His right hand.

verses.kjv: Yea, he loved the people; all his saints are in thy hand: and they sat down at thy feet; every one shall receive of thy words.
verses.modern: Yes, He loved His people, all His holy ones were in His hand; so they followed in Your steps, receiving direction from You,

verses.kjv: Moses commanded us a law, even the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.
verses.modern: when Moses commanded us a law, as a possession for the assembly of Jacob.

verses.kjv: And he was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people and the tribes of Israel were gathered together.
verses.modern: Thus the LORD became king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people were gathered, all the tribes of Israel together.

verses.kjv: Let Reuben live, and not die; and let not his men be few.
verses.modern: Let Reuben live, and not die, but let His men be few.

verses.kjv: And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, LORD, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people: let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help to him from his enemies.
verses.modern: this He said of Judah: "Hear, O LORD, the voice of Judah, and bring Him in to His people. let His hands be sufficient for Him, and be a help against His adversaries."

verses.kjv: And of Levi he said, Let thy Thummim and thy Urim be with thy holy one, whom thou didst prove at Massah, and with whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah;
verses.modern: of Levi He said, "Give to Levi Your Thummim, and Your Urim to Your godly one, whom You tested at Massah, with whom You quarreled at the waters of Meribah,

verses.kjv: Who said unto his father and to his mother, I have not seen him; neither did he acknowledge his brethren, nor knew his own children: for they have observed thy word, and kept thy covenant.
verses.modern: who said of His father and mother, 'I regard them not'; He disowned His brothers and ignored His children. For they observed Your word and kept Your covenant.

verses.kjv: They shall teach Jacob thy judgments, and Israel thy law: they shall put incense before thee, and whole burnt sacrifice upon thine altar.
verses.modern: They shall teach Jacob your rules and Israel your law; they shall put incense before you and whole burnt offerings on your altar.

verses.kjv: Bless, LORD, his substance, and accept the work of his hands: smite through the loins of them that rise against him, and of them that hate him, that they rise not again.
verses.modern: Bless, O LORD, His substance, and accept the work of His hands; crush the loins of His adversaries, of those who hate Him, that they rise not again."

verses.kjv: And of Benjamin he said, The beloved of the LORD shall dwell in safety by him; and the LORD shall cover him all the day long, and he shall dwell between his shoulders.
verses.modern: Of Benjamin He said, "The beloved of the LORD dwells in safety. The LORD shall cover Him all the day long, and He shall dwell between His shoulders."

verses.kjv: And of Joseph he said, Blessed of the LORD be his land, for the precious things of heaven, for the dew, and for the deep that coucheth beneath,
verses.modern: of Joseph he said, "Blessed by the LORD be His land, with the choicest gifts of heaven above, and of the deep that crouches beneath,

verses.kjv: And for the precious fruits brought forth by the sun, and for the precious things put forth by the moon,
verses.modern: with the choicest fruits of the sun and the rich yield of the months,

verses.kjv: And for the chief things of the ancient mountains, and for the precious things of the lasting hills,
verses.modern: with the finest produce of the ancient mountains and the abundance of the everlasting hills,

verses.kjv: And for the precious things of the earth and fulness thereof, and for the good will of him that dwelt in the bush: let the blessing come upon the head of Joseph, and upon the top of the head of him that was separated from his brethren.
verses.modern: with the best gifts of the earth and its fullness and the favor of him who dwells in the burning bush. May these rest on the head of Joseph, on the brow of him who was prince among his brothers.

verses.kjv: His glory is like the firstling of his bullock, and his horns are like the horns of unicorns: with them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth: and they are the ten thousands of Ephraim, and they are the thousands of Manasseh.
verses.modern: His glory is like the firstling of his bullock, and his horns are like the horns of unicorns. With them he shall push the peoples together to the ends of the earth. They are the ten thousands of Ephraim, and they are the thousands of Manasseh.

verses.kjv: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out; and, Issachar, in thy tents.
verses.modern: of Zebulun he said, "Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out, and Issachar, in your tents.

verses.kjv: They shall call the people unto the mountain; there they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness: for they shall suck of the abundance of the seas, and of treasures hid in the sand.
verses.modern: They shall call peoples to their mountain; there they offer right sacrifices; for they draw from the abundance of the seas and the hidden treasures of the sand."

verses.kjv: And of Gad he said, Blessed be he that enlargeth Gad: he dwelleth as a lion, and teareth the arm with the crown of the head.
verses.modern: of Gad he said, "Blessed be he who enlarges Gad! Gad crouches like a lion; he tears off arm and scalp.

verses.kjv: And he provided the first part for himself, because there, in a portion of the lawgiver, was he seated; and he came with the heads of the people, he executed the justice of the LORD, and his judgments with Israel.
verses.modern: He chose the best of the land for Himself, for there a commander's portion was reserved. He came with the heads of the people, with Israel he executed the justice of the LORD, and His judgments with Israel."

verses.kjv: And of Dan he said, Dan is a lion's whelp: he shall leap from Bashan.
verses.modern: of Dan He said, "Dan is a lion's cub that leaps from Bashan."

verses.kjv: And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, satisfied with favour, and full with the blessing of the LORD: possess thou the west and the south.
verses.modern: of Naphtali He said, "O Naphtali, satisfied with favor, and full of the blessing of the LORD, possess the lake and the south."

verses.kjv: And of Asher he said, Let Asher be blessed with children; let him be acceptable to his brethren, and let him dip his foot in oil.
verses.modern: of Asher He said, "Most blessed of sons be Asher; let Him be the favorite of His brothers, and let Him dip His foot in oil.

verses.kjv: Thy shoes shall be iron and brass; and as thy days, so shall thy strength be.
verses.modern: Your bars shall be iron and bronze, and as Your days, so shall Your strength be.

verses.kjv: There is none like unto the God of Jeshurun, who rideth upon the heaven in thy help, and in his excellency on the sky.
verses.modern: There is none like God, O Jeshurun, who rides through the heavens to Your help, through the skies in His majesty.

verses.kjv: The eternal God is thy refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy them.
verses.modern: The eternal God is Your dwelling place, and underneath are the everlasting arms. and He shall thrust out the enemy from before you and shall say, Destroy them.

verses.kjv: Israel then shall dwell in safety alone: the fountain of Jacob shall be upon a land of corn and wine; also his heavens shall drop down dew.
verses.modern: So Israel lived in safety, Jacob lived alone, in a land of grain and wine, whose heavens drop down dew.

verses.kjv: Happy art thou, O Israel: who is like unto thee, O people saved by the LORD, the shield of thy help, and who is the sword of thy excellency! and thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee; and thou shalt tread upon their high places.
verses.modern: Happy are You, O Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by the LORD, the shield of your help, and the sword of Your triumph! Your enemies shall come fawning to You, and You shall tread upon their high places."

chapters.summary: Moses blesses the twelve tribes of Israel before his death, tribe by tribe. He praises the LORD who rides on the heavens to Israel's help and declares that the eternal God is their refuge and underneath are the everlasting arms.

verses.kjv: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is over against Jericho. And the LORD shewed him all the land of Gilead, unto Dan,
verses.modern: Then Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, which is opposite Jericho. And the LORD showed Him all the land, Gilead as far as Dan,

verses.kjv: And all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim, and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, unto the utmost sea,
verses.modern: all Naphtali, the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, all the land of Judah as far as the western sea,

verses.kjv: And the south, and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, unto Zoar.
verses.modern: the south, and the Plain, that is, the Valley of Jericho the city of palm trees, as far as Zoar.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto him, This is the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, saying, I will give it unto thy seed: I have caused thee to see it with thine eyes, but thou shalt not go over thither.
verses.modern: the LORD said to Him, "This is the land of which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, 'I will give it to your seed.' I have let you see it with Your eyes, but You shall not go over there."

verses.kjv: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the LORD.
verses.modern: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And he buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, over against Bethpeor: but no man knoweth of his sepulchre unto this day.
verses.modern: he buried Him in the valley in the land of Moab opposite Beth-peor, but no one knows the place of his burial to this day.

verses.kjv: And Moses was an hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated.
verses.modern: Moses was 120 years old when he died. His eye was undimmed and his vigor unabated.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days: so the days of weeping and mourning for Moses were ended.
verses.modern: the people of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days. Then the days of weeping and mourning for Moses were ended.

verses.kjv: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom; for Moses had laid his hands upon him: and the children of Israel hearkened unto him, and did as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.modern: Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands on him. So the people of Israel obeyed him and did as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And there arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face,
verses.modern: there has not arisen a prophet since in Israel like Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face,

verses.kjv: In all the signs and the wonders, which the LORD sent him to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,
verses.modern: none like Him for all the signs and the wonders that the LORD sent Him to do in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh and to all his servants and to all his land,

verses.kjv: And in all that mighty hand, and in all the great terror which Moses shewed in the sight of all Israel.
verses.modern: for all the mighty power and all the great deeds of terror that Moses did in the sight of all Israel.

chapters.summary: Moses goes up Mount Nebo and the LORD shows him all the Promised Land from Gilead to the western sea. Moses dies there at 120 years old, his eye undimmed and his strength unabated, and the LORD buries him in an unknown grave. Joshua the son of Nun succeeds him, but no prophet like Moses has arisen in Israel since.
